products.title: Lattafa Khamrah Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Khamrah Eau De Parfum is a warm, spicy, and irresistibly sweet unisex fragrance that is an oriental charm with a modern twist. Known for its rich cinnamon and vanilla profile, Khamrah is a bold scent inspired by Arabian traditions and global luxury tastes. Often compared to high-end niche perfumes, Lattafa Khamrah offers an affordable alternative without compromising on quality or performance. This perfume is ideal for people who enjoy strong, lasting fragrances with a warm, dessert-like aroma.

products.title: Afnan Supremacy Collectors Edition Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Afnan Supremacy Collector’s Edition Eau de Parfum is a modern, fresh, and classy men’s fragrance that brings confidence with every spray. Inspired by timeless elegance, this scent mixes fruity freshness with warm woody notes, making it perfect for the man who wants to stand out.

The first spray greets you with a burst of juicy pineapple, crisp apple, and fresh bergamot balanced with delicate white flowers. As it settles, you’ll notice the heart of orange blossom, smooth birch, and warm amber adding depth and richness. The dry-down is where Afnan Supremacy Collector’s Edition Eau de Parfum shines earthy oak moss, clean musk, and unique ambergris, leaving a long-lasting, masculine trail that people won’t forget.

Whether you’re dressing up for a special event or adding a touch of class to your daily look, Afnan Supremacy Collector’s Edition Eau de Parfum is your perfect companion.

products.title: Afnan Turathi Blue Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Turathi Blue is a crisp, fresh, and uplifting scent crafted for the modern man. It starts with a burst of zesty bergamot and mandarin, creating an energizing first impression. The scent then drifts into warm amber, entwined with woody nuances, before finally resting on a base of smooth musk and patchouli with a touch of spice. Ideal for everyday wear, it is both refined and approachable with a touch of Middle Eastern richness.

products.title: Lattafa Asad Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Asad Eau de Parfum is a bold and rich fragrance for men from the house of Lattafa. Launched in 2021, it is a perfect mix of spicy, woody, and sweet notes. The top notes of black pepper, tobacco, and pineapple give it a fresh yet spicy start. The heart combines patchouli, coffee, and iris for a warm and smooth feel. The base of vanilla, amber, dry wood, benzoin, and labdanum makes it linger on skin with a deep, oriental touch.

products.title: Afnan Supremacy Not Only Intense Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan Supremacy Not Only Intense EDP Spray is a rich and masculine fragrance with a deep, contemporary and smoky character balanced by fruity freshness. The perfume creates a unique scent that lasts all day, smoothly blending crisp apple and bergamot with warm saffron notes and dark musky undertones.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Kaaf Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Kaaf Extrait de Parfum was launched in 2022 by the Ahmed Al Maghribi fragrance house as a fresh aquatic fragrance with a floral and fruity composition and a musky drydown. It has the top notes of red fruits, watermelon, lavender and Sicilian orange; a heart of sweet floral bouquet of lotus, jasmine, and lily of the valley; and a musky base with warm sandalwood and Ambroxan

products.title: Afnan 9PM Rebel Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan 9PM Rebel Eau de Parfum is a new unisex perfume launched in 2024 by Afnan Perfumes. It was created by perfumer Gaël Montero it is a fruity-aromatic scent with a playful yet classy touch. The perfume opens with juicy pineapple, fresh green apple and sweet mandarin (top notes). The middle notes combine creamy vanilla, oakmoss and cedarwood for a smooth balance. Finally, the base leaves a warm trail of ambergris, dry woods, caramel and musk that lingers beautifully.

products.title: Lattafa Asad Bourbon Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Asad Bourbon Eau de Parfum is a modern and wealthy oriental spicy perfume for men. The scent is warm, deep, and bold, and it is suitable for men who love strong and powerful scents. Lavender is fresh, mirabelle is juicy and pink pepper adds a small kick at the very beginning of the fragrance. The heart is cacao, nutmeg, and davana mixed; dark and rich, giving a sweet but spicy feel. The dry down consists of vanilla, amber, and vetiver which are smooth and thick thus making it creamy, manly, and comforting at the same time.

products.title: Afnan  Modest Une Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan Modest Une Eau de Parfum is a modern men’s fragrance that was launched in 2019. It is an aromatic spicy combination made for men who like fresh, bold and long-lasting perfumes. The opening comes with sharp pepper, soothing lavender, cool mint and spicy nutmeg. The middle notes bring citrus, warm amber and refreshing eucalyptus. The base is masculine with musk, vetiver and cedarwood giving it depth and strength that stays for hours.

products.title: Yves Saint Laurent Y Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Y Eau de Parfum Yves Saint Laurent for Men is a fresh, modern, and confident fragrance that balances crisp freshness with deep woody notes. Inspired by the spirit of the contemporary man who dares to dream, this scent embodies boldness, freedom, and a touch of class.

The opening is refreshing, featuring juicy apple, spicy ginger, and zesty bergamot. In the heart, Y Eau de Parfum Yves Saint Laurent for Men brings aromatic sage, vibrant geranium, and juniper berries, giving it a green yet slightly floral twist. The base notes wrap you in warm amberwood, smooth tonka bean, rich cedar, vetiver, and olibanum, creating a long-lasting masculine trail.

Y Eau de Parfum Yves Saint Laurent for Men is perfect for those who love versatile, everyday scents with a signature edge. One spray is enough to make you feel fresh, stylish, and ready to conquer your day.

products.title: Lattafa Fakhar Men Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Fakhar Men Eau De Parfum is a rich oriental scent made for confident men who love strong, fresh and woody notes. Launched in 2022, this perfume opens with bright and spicy touches of apple, bergamot and ginger. The heart consists of a soft and smooth mix of lavender, sage, juniper berries and geranium that is cool yet masculine. The tonka bean, amberwood and vetiver make a powerful, warm and woody base that lasts for hours.

products.title: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Eau Intense Men Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Eau Intense Pour Homme Eau De Parfum is a fresh and clean fragrance for men. It makes one experience of a cool ocean breeze on a hot, sunny day. It was launched in 2017. The Eau De Parfum begins with a sweet burst of grapefruit scent along with mandarin orange. The heart tones are surrounded by the warm musk  and amberwood smell. The soft and confident smell makes you effortlessly attractive on any day.

products.title: Mancera Cedrat Boise Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Mancera Cedrat Boise Eau De Parfum is a bright, fresh, and modern unisex fragrance that mixes juicy citrus with smooth woods and soft musk. Inspired by sunny days and easy elegance, this perfume opens with a splash of zesty Sicilian lemon, refreshing bergamot, and a hint of spicy black currant. As it settles, fruity notes blend with soft jasmine and earthy patchouli leaf, adding depth and charm. The dry-down is warm and creamy with cedar, leather, vanilla, and white musk that stay on your skin for hours.

Mancera Cedrat Boise is a perfect everyday fragrance for people who love fresh, energetic scents with a classy twist. It feels youthful yet sophisticated, making it a favourite for both men and women who want to smell fresh, clean, and stylish all day long.

products.title: Burberry Goddess Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Burberry Goddess EDP Spray is a gourmand aromatic fragrance for women, launched in 2023. The fragrance stands out with a triple vanilla infusion, offering a warm and creamy sweetness to the overall scent. The fresh herbal touch of lavender adds to the depth and complexity of the fragrance and makes it suitable for colder seasons of the year or special occasions.

products.title: Lattafa Khamrah Dukhan Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Khamrah Dukhan Eau de Parfum is a creamy oriental scent for men from the house of Lattafa Perfumes. Launched in 2025, it combines smoky, spicy and sweet notes that wrap around you like warm air. It begins with the spiciness of pimento and the freshness of mandarin, and then goes to deep incense, labdanum and orange blossom. The base contains soft praline, tobacco, amber and tonka bean which result in a smooth and creamy finish.

products.title: Ajmal Kuro Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Ajmal Kuro is designed for the modern Indian gent who wants the punch of a designer perfume without the designer price tag. The first spray bursts open with cool bergamot and lively pepper, giving a crisp “wake‑up” feel that cuts through humidity. Just seconds later, elegant French lavender and bright geranium step in, smoothing the edges and adding a clean, shirt‑fresh vibe. Deeper down, earthy vetiver, patchouli, and a whisper of ambergris ground the scent and help it cling to skin and fabric long after sundown. Think of it as a confident handshake that turns into an all‑day friendship, easy to like, hard to forget, and perfect for the office, college campus, or a late‑night drive.

products.title: Versace Eros Man Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Versace Eros Man Eau De Parfum is a bold, fresh, and sensual men’s fragrance inspired by the Greek god of love Eros. Just like its name, this perfume is all about passion and power. It opens with an amazing blast of mint, sweet candy apple, and zesty citrus fruits. As it settles, warm ambroxan and fresh geranium add depth and masculinity. Finally, a smooth blend of vanilla, cedar, and leather wraps you in a warm, confident finish.

Versace Eros Man Eau De Parfum is perfect for modern men who want to feel strong, attractive, and unforgettable. A few sprays will boost your confidence and turn heads wherever you go.

products.title: Nautica Voyage Man Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Nautica Voyage Eau De Toilette for men is a fresh, clean and easy-going fragrance from the house of Nautica. It is made for daily wear and feels light, cool and relaxing. The scent opens with crisp green leaves and juicy apple that feels very fresh on first spray. The heart of the fragrance introduces the very gentle floral notes of lotus and mimosa that provide a creamy and watery sensation. Finally, musk, cedar, oakmoss and amber round up the scent’s drying process, making it a very clean but to a great extent still gentle and pleasant woody base on the skin.

products.title: Lattafa Al Nashma Caprice Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Al Nashma Caprice Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex fragrance from the house of Lattafa Perfumes. Its launch in 2024 revealed the mixture of spicy, citrus, and woody notes in a fresh and elegant perfume. The composition starts with the lively cardamom, ginger, bergamot, and lemon that serve the energetic and clean opening. Lavender, geranium, and mint form the middle, with their soft, herbal, and calming touch added to the composition. The base is composed of amber, cedarwood, patchouli, and vetiver that create a warm and smooth long-lasting dry down on skin.

products.title: Lattafa Jasoor Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Jasoor Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex perfume that gives a bold and confident vibe. Launched in 2023 by the house of Lattafa, it brings a fresh and spicy mix that feels both clean and deep. The perfume opens with juicy apple, spicy cardamom and fresh bergamot. The middle notes brings in warm tobacco, lavender and floral geranium. The dry-down is rich with tonka bean, leather, vetiver and patchouli.

products.title: Davidoff Cool Water Man Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Davidoff Cool Water Man Eau De Toilette is a classic men’s perfume known for its cool, fresh and confident vibe. Launched in 1988, it’s still a favorite for those who love clean and ocean-like scents. It starts with a mix of mint, green notes, lavender and rosemary, giving a crisp freshness, then brings soft hints of sandalwood, jasmine, and geranium. Finally, the base adds depth with musk, cedar, ambergris and tobacco, making it long lasting, masculine and refreshing all day.

products.title: Giorgio Armani Stronger With You Absolutely Parfum
products.body_html: Giorgio Armani Stronger With You Absolutely EDP is that cozy, confident scent you grab when you want to feel like the best version of yourself. It kicks off with a boozy rum splash mixed with bright bergamot and a resin kick from elemi, then slides into lavender and davana that smell clean yet a little wild. Chestnut, Madagascar vanilla, cedar, and patchouli wrap it up warm and woody, like a hug that lasts. Cecile Matton put this together in 2021, building on the Stronger With You line to say love is strong, stay true. Guys in the fragrance world love how it mixes sweet booze with fresh herbs, perfect for dates or nights out, with solid staying power and a trail that turns heads.

products.title: Azzaro The Most Wanted Parfum
products.body_html: Azzaro The Most Wanted Parfum is a bold and irresistible fragrance for men who love to make a lasting impression. Launched in 2022, this woody spicy scent blends warm bourbon vanilla with fresh ginger and rich woodsy notes. It’s a strong yet smooth perfume, perfect for men who are confident, daring, and never afraid to stand out. The sleek black bottle with a gun-chamber design reflects power and elegance, just like the scent inside.

products.title: Ajmal Silver Shade Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Ajmal Silver Shade Eau De Parfum is a fresh, modern, and energetic unisex fragrance that feels like a cool mountain breeze in a bottle. This scent is designed for the stylish individual who loves a clean and uplifting aroma. It beautifully balances zesty citrus fruits with soft florals and a clean, musky base, creating a perfectly refreshing and sophisticated experience.

Silver Shade smells yet smooth, with a touch of class that makes it incredibly versatile. It’s the perfect choice for anyone who wants a signature scent that is easy to wear daily but still makes a statement. A spray of Ajmal Silver Shade will leave you feeling confident, fresh, and ready to conquer your day with effortless style.

products.title: Louis Vuitton Afternoon Swim Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Louis Vuitton Afternoon Swim Eau De Parfum is a bright, juicy and refreshing citrus scent made for people who love clean and energetic summer perfumes. It opens with a strong blast of mandarin and orange that feels like fresh sunshine on skin. The bergamot adds a soft sparkle, while ginger and ambergris give it a warm, salty, slightly sweet twist that dries down clean.

products.title: Afnan 9AM Dive Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan 9AM Dive Eau de Parfum is a fresh aquatic fragrance for both men and women that was Launched in 2022 it brings a cooling and energising feel that is perfect for warm days. The perfume starts with bright lemon, mint, black currant and pink pepper (top notes). In the middle, it turns smooth with apple, cedar and incense. The base carries ginger, sandalwood, patchouli and jasmine creating a balanced, refreshing yet slightly woody scent.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Bin Shaikh Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html:
Ahmed Al Maghribi Bin Shaikh Eau de Parfum is an elegant oriental fragrance for both men and women. Inspired by rich Arabic traditions and royal gatherings, this scent wraps you in warmth, sweetness, and a soft floral touch.

Bin Shaikh combines the beauty of fresh roses, exotic saffron, and earthy oak moss with a sweet heart of bakhoor, sugar, jasmine, and violet. The dry down is deep and comforting with oud, amber, ambroxan, musk, and patchouli creating a luxurious trail.

Ahmed Al Maghribi Bin Shaikh Eau de Parfum is perfect for those who love sweet, woody scents with a hint of floral freshness. Just a few sprays make you feel confident, royal, and ready for any special moment.

products.title: Armaf Tres Nuit Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Armaf Tres Nuit Eau de Parfum is a fresh and spicy scent made specially for men. It opens bright with lemon, iris, and vervain, giving a citrusy and green start. The middle notes move into lavender, violet, and some spicy touches that make it elegant and smooth. At the base, ambergris and sandalwood bring depth and warmth, making it a timeless perfume that feels both clean and classy.

products.title: Dumont Nitro Red Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Dumont Nitro Red Eau de Parfum is a bold and energetic perfume for men. Launched in 2020, it opens with fresh and fruity top notes of apple, lavender and bergamot. The combination of juicy watermelon, warm cedar and spicy calamus, while the base gives a rich finish with amber, sandalwood and patchouli. It is a modern scent that balances fruity freshness with woody warmth, perfect for everyday wear or special occasions.

products.title: Calvin Klein Ck One Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Calvin Klein CK One Eau de Toilette is one of the most famous unisex perfume in the world which was launched in 1994 it brings a fresh and clean vibe that feels natural on both men and women. The Fragrance starts with citrus fruits like lemon, bergamot and mandarin orange, mixed with pineapple, green notes, cardamom and papaya and the middle brings a soft floral touch with jasmine, violet, rose, freesia, lily of the valley, nutmeg and orris root. The base is warm and balanced with green tea, sandalwood, musk, cedar, oakmoss, amber and green accords. CK One is simple, cool and made for everyday wear.

products.title: Azzaro Most Wanted Eau De Parfum Intense
products.body_html:
Azzaro The Most Wanted Eau De Parfum Intense is a daring new fragrance for men launched in 2024. This EDP Intense edition builds on the success of the Most Wanted line with a fresher, deeper, and more sensual twist. The blend is bold yet refined, starting with a vibrant bergamot note, flowing into smooth lavender, and finishing with a mysterious moss and liquor accord.

Crafted for confident, modern men, Azzaro The Most Wanted Intense delivers a crisp aromatic edge balanced with dark sensuality. The result? A signature scent that feels energizing, powerful, and long-lasting.

products.title: Armaf Club de Nuit Intense Man Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Armaf Club de Nuit Intense Man Eau de Toilette is one of the most talked-about scents in the men’s fragrance world which was released in 2015 it has a sharp, fresh and bold profile that combines fruity, floral and woody notes in one bottle. The perfume starts with a blast of lemon, pineapple, bergamot, black currant and apple giving a citrusy yet sweet start. The middle slowly brings in smoky birch, soft jasmine and gentle rose. The endnotes are smooth and long-lasting with musk, ambergris, patchouli and a touch of vanilla which adds warmth and depth.

products.title: Armaf Club De Nuit Sillage Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Armaf Club De Nuit Sillage Eau De Parfum is a unisex fragrance launched in 2020. It is a bright and fresh perfume that opens with citrus and fruity notes of bergamot, lemon, black currant, lime, violet leaf, and ginger. The middle notes are soft florals like rose, iris, and jasmine and the final notes settle into a classy combination of ambroxan, musk, sandalwood, and cedar. It is a fragrance that feels clean, modern, and versatile, perfect for everyday wear or special evenings.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Blu Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Blue Oud Eau de Parfum is a unisex signature perfume from the house of Ahmed Al Maghribi Fragrances. Launched in 2024, it is a bold take on a fresh and woody DNA profile consisting of leather, bergamot, and cypress (top notes); geranium and violet leaf (heart notes); and agarwood, patchouli, and musk (base notes) mixed seamlessly into a smooth composition with classic Middle Eastern accords of oud, incense, and guaiac wood.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Oud & Roses Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Oud & Roses is a unisex fresh floriantel Eau de Parfum from the Ahmed Al Maghribi fragrance house. It has a vibrant open of zesty lemon balanced by floral peony lavender and turkish rose, a heart of warm sandalwood, frankincense and white flowers and a musky-amber base mixed with oud, oakmoss, and guaiac wood.

products.title: Ajmal Blue Homme Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Ajmal Blue Homme Eau De Parfum was launched in 2013 by Ajmal fragrance house that is based in UAE as a fresh aquatic scent with a touch of citric and floral notes. It opens with Citric bergamot, flowery lavender and fruity watermelon; with time it diffuses off the top notes and the heart notes of Lotus and jasmine becomes more prominent and finally it has a soft and musky drydown with its amber, musk and sandalwood notes.

products.title: Yves Saint Laurent La Nuit De L'homme Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Yves Saint Laurent La Nuit De L’Homme Eau De Toilette is a dark, attractive, and classy men’s fragrance that feels smooth and spicy. It starts with an aroma of cardamom that is fresh and spicy at the same time; this note feels warm and a little sweet. Gradually, lavender and bergamot introduce a soft and clean aspect while cedar provides a woody impression. The foundation of vetiver and caraway renders the fragrance rich and sensual. This perfume gives off a vibe of confidence, romance, and it’s just right for men who prefer calm yet strong scents.

products.title: Lattafa Liam Grey Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Liam Grey Eau de Parfum is a classy and modern unisex fragrance that brings together warmth and freshness in a very balanced way. Launched in 2023, it’s a mix of spicy cardamom, sweet fig and rich black tea at the top. The heart opens with soft iris, vetiver and labdanum, giving a smooth and deep texture. The dry down is warm and creamy with vanilla, sandalwood, tonka and patchouli. It feels elegant and calm, perfect for daily wear or evening outings.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Azure Royal Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Ahmed Al Maghribi Azure Royal Eau de Parfum is a fresh, elegant, and modern unisex fragrance that beautifully blends fruity sweetness with soft floral touches and warm woody notes. Inspired by royalty and calm blue skies, this scent opens with juicy pear and sweet citrus notes that instantly lift your mood.

At its heart, Ahmed Al Maghribi Azure Royal Eau de Parfum blooms with freesia and rose, giving a clean and graceful floral vibe. The base is warm and comforting with soft musk and smooth cedarwood, adding depth and a gentle touch of luxury that stays with you all day.

If you love fragrances that feel light yet royal, Azure Royal is a perfect choice for daily wear, special dinners, and every moment you want to feel fresh and confident.

products.title: Yves Saint Laurent Y Le Parfum
products.body_html:
Yves Saint Laurent Y Le Parfum is the ultimate expression of modern masculinity, confidence, and success. This fragrance is a deep, intense, and incredibly smooth take on the iconic Y signature. It masterfully balances vibrant freshness with a powerful, dark elegance, creating a scent that is both bold and sophisticated.

Y Le Parfum smells like ambition in a bottle. It opens with a fresh burst of crisp apple and zesty grapefruit, then settles into a clean, aromatic heart of lavender and sage. The real magic happens in the base, where warm tonka bean and rich woods provide a deep, long-lasting trail that feels luxurious and powerful. It’s the perfect fragrance for the man who is bold, ambitious, and carves his path.

products.title: Valentino Uomo Born In Roma Intense Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Valentino Uomo Born In Roma Intense Eau De Parfum is a bold, sensual, and modern fragrance for men who want to stand out. Inspired by the Roman nights, this perfume celebrates confidence, style, and the rebellious spirit of Rome.

Valentino Uomo Born In Roma Intense starts with a sweet and creamy vanilla note that feels warm and inviting. A touch of fresh lavender in the heart keeps it classy and smooth. The base of vetiver adds a deep, masculine, and elegant finish that stays on the skin for hours.

This perfume is intense but easy to wear. It's perfect for men who want to feel confident and attractive on special occasions or romantic dates. A few sprays of Valentino Uomo Born In Roma Intense Eau De Parfum will make you feel powerful and stylish, ready to own the night.

products.title: Armaf Club de Nuit Iconic Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Armaf Club de Nuit Blue Iconic Eau de Parfum is a fragrance for men that gives a combination of fresh, spicy and woody notes which was launched in 2022 it opens with a bright and zesty combination of grapefruit, lemon, mint, pink pepper and coriander. The middle notes are ginger, melon, nutmeg and jasmine adding a warm yet fresh touch. In the end you will find woody notes, incense, sandalwood, amber, cedar, patchouli and labdanum which together create a masculine finish.

products.title: Lattafa His Confession Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa His Confession Eau de Parfum is a bold and deep scent for men. It’s a warm oriental-woody perfume that mixes spicy, sweet and smoky tones beautifully. The fragrance opens with cinnamon, lavender and mandarin for a spicy-fresh start. The middle brings soft iris, cypress, benzoin and floral mahonial. The base settles into creamy vanilla, tonka, amber, incense, cedarwood and patchouli giving a rich and warm trail.

products.title: Afnan Supremacy Incense Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Afnan Supremacy Incense Eau de Parfum is a bold, aromatic fragrance made for men who love rich, smoky, and spicy scents. This perfume mixes fresh herbs, warm spices, deep resins, and dark woods to create a unique scent that feels powerful and masculine.

Inspired by the mystery of smoky incense burning in a grand hall, Afnan Supremacy Incense Eau de Parfum wraps you in layers of fresh bergamot, spicy oregano, and herbal notes. As it settles, the heart opens with opoponax, warm amber, and labdanum that add a smooth sweetness. Finally, the base brings strong smoky notes, oud, leather, and earthy patchouli that stay on your skin for hours.

If you want to stand out at any party, wedding, or special dinner, Afnan Supremacy Incense Eau de Parfum will make sure you get noticed for your bold and classy taste.

products.title: Lattafa Emeer Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Emeer Eau de Parfum is a new unisex perfume launched in 2024 by the house of Lattafa. It is a classy and modern scent with a nice mix of citrus, woods and spice. The perfume opens fresh with lemon, bergamot, clary sage and juniper berries, giving a cool and clean feeling. As it settles, white tea, sandalwood, cardamom and olibanum bring warmth and smoothness. The dry down has ambergris, cedarwood, cashmeran and patchouli that make it deep, cozy, and long-lasting.

products.title: Lattafa Bade'e Al Oud Amethyst Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Bade’e Al Oud Amethyst Eau de Parfum is a unisex fragrance with a smooth and elegant oriental vanilla scent. Launched in 2021, it opens with fresh and spicy top notes of pink pepper and bergamot, followed by the floral heart of Turkish rose, Bulgarian rose, and jasmine. The base is rich and warm with agarwood (oud), amber, and vanilla.

products.title: Afnan Turathi Brown Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Afnan Turathi Brown Eau de Parfum is a classy, warm, and spicy fragrance designed for men who love to stand out. This perfume brings together rich woody notes, fresh spices, and smooth amber to create a bold yet inviting scent.

Launched in 2023, Afnan Turathi Brown smells modern but carries a timeless touch. With every spray, you get a burst of fresh spices, warm amber, and smooth vanilla that lasts all day. It’s perfect for men who want to feel confident and elegant, whether it’s for daily wear or special evenings.

If you enjoy strong, warm perfumes that leave a lasting impression wherever you go, Afnan Turathi Brown Eau de Parfum is worth trying.

products.title: Yves Saint Laurent Myslf Le Parfum
products.body_html:
Yves Saint Laurent Myslf Le Parfum is the scent of modern confidence. It is a bold, magnetic, and deeply expressive fragrance for the man who is unapologetically himself. This perfume captures a powerful and sophisticated feeling, combining a fresh, spicy kick with a warm heart.

Myslf Le Parfum smells like pure charm and character. It is smooth, inviting, and has a touch of mystery, making it perfect for the man who wants to make a memorable statement without saying a word. A few sprays of Yves Saint Laurent Myslf Le Parfum will boost your confidence and leave an unforgettable impression of modern elegance.

products.title: Versace Eros Eau De Toilette
products.body_html:
Versace Eros Eau De Toilette is a bold, fresh, and sensual men’s fragrance inspired by Greek mythology and the god of love, Eros. This fragrance is designed for the strong, passionate man who lives life with confidence and desire.

The scent opens with a burst of cool mint, crisp green apple, and juicy lemon, giving an instant feeling of freshness and energy. The heart of Versace Eros Eau De Toilette adds warmth with sweet tonka bean, soft ambroxan, and aromatic geranium. In the base, rich Madagascar vanilla blends with strong cedarwood, vetiver, and oakmoss to create a masculine, long-lasting finish.

Versace Eros Eau De Toilette is the perfect choice if you want to feel powerful, attractive, and unforgettable.

products.title: Rayhaan Tiger Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rayhaan Tiger Eau de Parfum is a bold, woody, spicy perfume for men who like strong yet smooth perfumes. It opens with a warm, spicy blend of nutmeg, clove and lemon that feels fresh yet deep. The middle has a soft, creamy touch of milk blended with rose and davana, offering a slightly sweet, smooth texture. The base settles into creamy notes of amber, patchouli, frankincense and labdanum that feel warm, resinous and long lasting.

products.title: Giorgio Armani Acqua Di Gio Parfum
products.body_html:
Giorgio Armani Acqua Di Gio Parfum stands as a modern, profound interpretation of the legendary Acqua Di Gio collection. It masterfully achieves balance by merging the invigorating freshness of marine notes with the inherent richness of woody undertones, resulting in a fragrance that projects both purity and significant power. 

The opening sequence delivers the bright, airy freshness of marine notes and bergamot, creating an initial impression reminiscent of a clean sea breeze and crisp citrus. This evolves into an aromatic core of rosemary, clary sage, and geranium, which introduces a distinct herbal depth. Finally, the scent anchors itself with warm notes of olibanum and patchouli, providing a grounded, lasting, and deeply masculine trail. Crafted by master perfumer Alberto Morillas, this fragrance is built on a foundation of clean, confident, and enduring sophistication, making it an ideal choice for the man who values an effortlessly elegant and timeless scent.

products.title: Armaf Odyssey Limoni Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Armaf Odyssey Limoni Eau de Parfum is a unisex fragrance that is fresh, pure, and luminous. It is characterized by an intense citrus opening of lemon, orange, mandarin, and bergamot that is very revitalizing and vigorous. Then, the ginger gives a smooth fresh feel to the orange blossom and light marine notes, which are soft in character. The underlying tea, musk, and amber create a composed and uncomplicated fragrance that is ideal for everyday use and warm days.

products.title: Ajmal Wisal Dahab Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Ajmal Wisal Dahab Eau De Parfum is like liquid gold in a bottle. An elegant and sophisticated unisex fragrance, it perfectly balances fresh fruits, beautiful flowers, and warm woods. The name "Dhahab" means "gold" in Arabic, and this scent truly lives up to its name, offering a rich and luxurious experience.

Wisal Dahab smells classy, modern, and incredibly charming. It's designed for those who appreciate a fragrance that is both noticeable and graceful. A spray of Ajmal Wisal Dahab makes you feel confident and ready for any occasion, wrapping you in a beautiful golden aura of fruit and flowers.

products.title: Afnan Historic Olemeda Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan Historic Olemeda Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex perfume from the house of Afnan which was released in 2022. It is built around a fresh and spicy DNA with sparkling citrus, spices and woody accords. The perfume starts with grapefruit, pink pepper, juniper and cardamom, all are the top notes of this perfume. The middle notes are Calabrian bergamot, cedar, nutmeg and jasmine and the final notes are ambergris, apple, musk and patchouli for a deep long-lasting impression. This fragrance is designed as a versatile everyday signature with a balance of fresh energy and warm sensuality.

products.title: Giorgio Armani Code Parfum
products.body_html: Giorgio Armani Code Parfum for men is a bold, sensual evening scent that mixes fresh bergamot and green bergamot leaf at the start, flows into a powdery heart of iris, aldehydes, clary sage, and orris, then settles into a warm base of tonka bean and cedar. Created by Antoine Maisondieu in 2022, it keeps the classic Code DNA but adds more depth and sensitivity. People in the fragrance world call it the modern king of night scents, strong yet soft, with an amazing blend of notes, top-notch quality, and projection that fills the room just right, sillage that lingers nicely without being too much.

products.title: Mancera Red Tobacco Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Mancera Red Tobacco Eau De Parfum is a bold and heavy unisex scent known for its rich, smoky and sweet spicy style. It starts loud with warm cinnamon, oud, incense, saffron, nutmeg and some fruity green apple and pear. Then it melts into a simple heart of patchouli and jasmine. The dry down comes strong with thick tobacco, sweet vanilla, amber, sandalwood, guaiac wood, white musk and vetiver.

products.title: Afnan Supremacy in Heaven Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Afnan Supremacy in Heaven Eau de Parfum is a fresh, clean, and classy fragrance for men who love to feel cool and confident. Inspired by clear blue skies and a fresh breeze, Afnan Supremacy in Heaven brings together citrus and green notes with a smooth woody base.

This fragrance feels like wearing a crisp white shirt on a sunny day, simple yet very sophisticated. With every spray of Afnan Supremacy in Heaven, you get a burst of fresh bergamot and mandarin orange, followed by soothing green tea and black currant. The base of musk and sandalwood keeps it soft, clean, and long-lasting.

Perfect for everyday wear or special occasions when you want to smell fresh, neat, and modern.

products.title: Rasasi Shuhrah Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Shuhrah Eau de Parfum is a strong and classy fragrance for the modern man. The fragrance begins with the very lively and vibrant top notes of tomato leaf, rose and freesia. It then transforms into a floral and woody heart of rose, sandalwood, cedar and jasmine. Finally, it wraps up with a base that provides a rich and warm finish through the combination of leather, oud, musk, oakmoss and amber.

products.title: Ajmal Shiro Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Ajmal Shiro Eau De Parfum is a sharp, fresh, and energetic fragrance designed for the modern man who lives life on the go.1 The name "Shiro," meaning white in Japanese, perfectly captures its clean, crisp, and confident vibe. This perfume is an amazing mix of fresh fruits, cool watery notes, and warm woods that makes you feel instantly refreshed and ready to take on the day.

Shiro smells modern yet timeless. It has the energy of a summer morning and the confidence of a sharp suit. It’s the perfect choice for men who want a versatile, high-quality scent that works for every occasion, from the office to a casual day out. A few sprays of Ajmal Shiro will leave you smelling clean, magnetic, and effortlessly stylish.

products.title: Armaf Hunter Intense Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Armaf Hunter Intense Eau de Parfum is a masculine woody aromatic fragrance from the house of Armaf. It starts with a burst of citrus freshness from bergamot, pomelo, mandarin, orange and lemon and in the middle notes, a floral twist with lavender, geranium, tuberose and ylang-ylang then balances freshness with elegance. The final notes end in a warm and spicy trail of black pepper and cardamom, creating a bold yet smooth finish. This fragrance is designed for men who like energetic, confident and modern scents that last throughout the day.

products.title: Giorgio Armani Acqua Di Gio Profumo Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Giorgio Armani Acqua Di Gio Profumo EDP for men is a deep smoky take on the fresh classic, opens with cool sea notes and sharp bergamot, heart brings rosemary sage geranium, base hits with incense and patchouli. Crafted by Alberto Morillas back in 2015. Fragrance fans rave about it as the grown-up version, richer, darker with that churchy incense twist, great projection sillage that turns heads.

products.title: Dolce & Gabbana The One Pour Homme Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Dolce & Gabbana The One Pour Homme Eau De Parfum is a classic and men’s scent that mixes warm, spicy and woody notes into one elegant blend. It opens with fresh grapefruit, coriander and basil that feel clean and confident. The heart brings spicy touches of cardamom, ginger and a hint of orange blossom. The dry down is smooth and deep with amber, tobacco and cedar giving it a warm, masculine finish. It’s a perfect perfume for men who love a classy, charming scent that lasts through the day.

products.title: Giorgio Armani Si Fiori Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Giorgio Armani Si Fiori EDP feels like your favourite light dress on a perfect spring day – simple, pretty, and makes you smile the second you put it on. Right when you spray, black currant and green mandarin hit you with this juicy, happy pop, like fruit straight from the market. Then it softens into neroli and rose that smell fresh-picked, with just a whisper of patchouli and oakmoss to keep it real. Vanilla and white musk hug you at the end, warm but never heavy. Julie Massé cooked this up in 2019 to say, “hey, be you, even when the city’s loud”. Perfume fans rave about how easy it is to wear all day, sweet enough to lift your mood, light enough to never bug anyone.

products.title: Prada Paradoxe Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: In the world of perfume, Prada Paradoxe Eau De Parfum is one of the certainly women's fragrances that are soft, fresh, and modern that smell clean and elegant. Fresh fruity accords of pear and citrus notes with their bright and smooth character immediately attract attention. Very gently, the white flowers likened to orange blossom and jasmine take the front, thus creating a creamy and feminine aura. At the end of the day, vanilla and amber bring in warmth and softness that remain on the skin for a long time. The whole fragrance is classy, soft, and ideal for everyday use.

products.title: Dunhill Icon Elite Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Dunhill Icon Elite Eau De Parfum is a classy and confident men’s scent that speaks style and strength. It was launched in 2016 by Alfred Dunhill, a brand known for luxury and refinement. The fragrance opens with fresh and bright top notes of cardamom, bitter orange, bergamot and lime. In the middle, the warm heart reveals vetiver, black pepper, blue sage and juniper which give a spicy and clean charm. The dry down is smooth with base notes of ebony, sandalwood, suede and labdanum giving it a deep and masculine finish.

products.title: Giorgio Armani Acqua Di Gio Absolu Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Giorgio Armani Acqua Di Gio Absolu Eau De Parfum is a refined fragrance that infuses woody and fresh notes. This is a perfect example of balance between warmth of woods and energy of the sea. Perfumer Alberto Morillas created this scent in 2018. He is a master perfumer who has been working with Acqua di Gio since 1996. This marine-woody scent also infuses fruity notes, presenting a unique masculine mixture of marine aromas with patchouli. It celebrates a vital, natural sensuality. The best part is that it combines the fragrances of the Sea Notes, Bergamot, pear, Apple, Grapefruit, Lemon, Lavender, Rosemary, Geranium, Woody notes, Tinka Bean, Amberwood, Patchaiu and Labdanum.

products.title: Lattafa Badee Al Oud Sublime Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Badee Al Oud Sublime Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex scent from the house of Lattafa Perfumes. It combines fresh, floral and woody notes that are very pleasant and have a long-lasting effect at the same time. The perfume starts with fruity and soft floral notes of apple, litchi and rose, which make a sweet and bright opening. As it develops, the heart reveals plum and jasmine that add a creamy floral depth. The base brings warm notes of moss, vanilla and patchouli, leaving a rich, elegant trail that remains for hours.

products.title: Bvlgari Wood Essence Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Bvlgari Man Wood Essence Eau de Parfum is a bold, refreshing, and modern fragrance crafted for the urban man who never loses his connection to nature. It beautifully blends strong woody notes with fresh citrus and earthy green tones, making it perfect for men who are grounded yet ambitious.

Inspired by the harmony between nature and city life, Bvlgari Man Wood Essence gives off the feeling of a calm forest breeze in the middle of a city. It’s rich, smooth, and vibrant, a perfect choice for men who want their fragrance to be fresh but also deep and masculine.

products.title: Ajmal Silver Shade Homme Deodrant
products.body_html: Ajmal SILVERSHADE HOMME Deodorant is a 200ml non-alcoholic body spray designed for men who value invigorating freshness and modern style. This dynamic fresh deodorant opens with an uplifting blend of citrus and fruity notes, instantly energising your senses. The heart reveals aromatic florals paired with cool spices, adding a sophisticated layer. A base of soft woods and musk ensures a smooth, lasting finish that feels clean and assured.

products.title: Bvlgari Man in Black Parfum
products.body_html: Bvlgari Man in Black Parfum is a bold, powerful, and intense fragrance crafted especially for the modern gentleman. Launched in 2024, Bvlgari Man in Black parfum is a deeper and richer version of the original Man in Black line by Bvlgari. It opens with a smoky spice that immediately catches attention, followed by warm leather, deep resins, and creamy vanilla. This fragrance is designed for men who want to leave a lasting impression with a scent that feels both luxurious and masculine. Whether you’re heading to a formal evening or a winter brunch, Bvlgari Man in Black Parfum is your perfect statement fragrance.

products.title: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Extreme Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Extreme Eau De Parfum is a bold oriental-woody fragrance made for men who love strong, deep, and daring scents. Launched in 2022, this perfume mixes fiery spices, rich cacao, earthy patchouli, and smoky incense into a daring yet classy blend. The fragrance opens with sharp freshness from bergamot and ginger, quickly moving into warm plum, clary sage, and exotic davana at the heart. The dry down is rich and intense with tonka bean, cacao, labdanum, patchouli, incense, and vetiver, leaving a lasting powerful trail.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Laathani Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Laathani Extrait de Parfum is a rich, bold and graceful unisex fragrance from the house of Ahmed Al Maghribi Fragrances known for its beast-level longivity and projection. It is a find blend of fresh bergamot and fruity pear top, floral rosemary and warm oud heart, and smoky bakhoor and heavy leather base.

products.title: Guy Laroche Drakkar Noir Eau De Toilette For Men
products.body_html: Drakkar Noir is a classic men’s fragrance with a bold, fresh, and clean scent. It opens with sharp citrus and herbs like lemon, lavender, and rosemary that feel very energising. Then it moves into spicy and green notes such as juniper, coriander, and jasmine that add depth. The base is warm, earthy, and masculine with oakmoss, leather, vetiver, fir, and patchouli. It is a timeless scent that many men use for daily wear, evenings, and even gym days because it smells confident and strong.

products.title: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Eau De Parfum is a bright, cheerful floral perfume for women who love sweet, joyful, and fresh fragrances. Inspired by the charm of blooming gardenia flowers, this perfume brings a burst of fruity sweetness with a soft floral heart that feels modern yet timeless.

Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Eau De Parfum is playful, feminine, and easy to wear every day. The scent opens with juicy red berries and pear blossom, adding a sparkling start. Then, the heart reveals creamy gardenia and jasmine that feel soft and romantic. Finally, a touch of sweet brown sugar and warm patchouli gives the fragrance a cozy, long-lasting finish. Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Eau De Parfum is like wearing a fresh flower crown, pretty, happy, and full of positive vibes.

products.title: Dunhill Icon Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Dunhill Icon Eau de Parfum is a classy and timeless perfume for men that combines modern freshness with warm woods. Launched in 2015, it brings together citrusy top notes of neroli and bergamot, followed by a spicy core of black pepper, lavender and cardamom. The base is creamy and masculine with vetiver, oakmoss, leather, iris and oud. It’s a perfume that wraps around you a feeling of elegance, confidence and being dressed up throughout the day.

products.title: Armaf Tag Him Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Armaf Tag Him Eau de Parfum is a men’s fragrance from the house of Armaf. It carries a strong woody spicy DNA that combines fresh citrus and spicy notes with warm woody accords. The opening comes alive with grapefruit, lemon, bergamot, and pink pepper, leading into a spicy heart of ginger, mint, lavender, and nutmeg. The scent finishes with earthy and deep base notes of vetiver, patchouli, sandalwood, and cedar. The combination is modern, youthful, and designed for men who enjoy energy and confidence in their fragrance.

products.title: Louis Vuitton Meteore Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Louis Vuitton Météore Eau de Parfum is a fresh and bright citrus perfume for men who like clean and powerful scents. The opening is full of juicy mandarin, Sicilian orange, and Calabrian bergamot, which is very sharp and fresh. The middle part of the perfume takes in Tunisian neroli along with spicy pink pepper, nutmeg, pepper, and cardamom that provide a warm spice kick. The base mostly consists of Java vetiver oil, which offers a clean, earthy aura and helps the fragrance to last on the skin.

products.title: Lattafa Maahir Gold Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Maahir Gold Eau De Parfum is a beautiful unisex perfume that mixes floral, fruity and warm oriental notes. The opening consists of red berries, peach and bergamot that are very sweet and juicy so they create a fresh and playful start. The heart reveals soft blossom of jasmine, peony and red lily. Then, the base of sandalwood, vanilla flower and musk create a creamy and warm dry-down that is become smart and long-lasting.

products.title: Dumont Nitro White Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Dumont Nitro White Eau de Parfum is a stylish and modern scent made for confident men. Launched in 2024, it opens with a clean, fresh touch of Juniper Berries, Iris and Cypress, which give it a cool and classy start. The middle adds Myrrh and Patchouli which offer a smooth and deep warmth. And the base combination of Honey, Vanilla, Amber, Musk and Leather provides a strong, masculine and comforting finish.

products.title: Lattafa Haya Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Haya Eau de Parfum is a charming and classy scent made for women who like something soft yet fresh. It opens with a sweet fruity sparkle of strawberry, champagne and tangerine, mixed with a hint of blood orange and rose. The middle of the perfume is made of gardenia, jasmine and vanilla orchid that provide a smooth floral note. The cozy finish is created by warm amber, sandalwood and chestnut in the base note, which also makes it close to the skin.

products.title: Davidoff Cool Water Man Reborn Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Davidoff Cool Water Man Reborn Eau de Parfum is a fresh, modern version of the classic Cool Water scent. It combines nature and strength with a clean, green and bold feel. The perfume starts with cool notes of galbanum and rosemary, giving a fresh and natural vibe. As it settles, Haitian vetiver adds a warm, earthy touch that feels smooth and lasting. Simple yet confident, this is the perfect perfume for men who like to feel refreshed, energetic and alive every day.

products.title: Afnan Supremacy Noir Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Afnan Supremacy Noir Eau de Parfum is a dark, classy, and mysterious fragrance for men and women who love bold and spicy scents. This perfume opens with a fresh touch of bergamot, violet, and spruce that adds a green, crisp feel. As the scent settles, you get warm notes of leather, pine tree, and lavender, which bring a smooth, deep vibe. The base of patchouli and labdanum adds richness and makes this fragrance last long.

Afnan Supremacy Noir Eau de Parfum feels powerful yet elegant, perfect for evening wear, parties, or when you want to feel confident and stylish. It leaves a warm, spicy trail that gets you compliments wherever you go.

products.title: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Eau de Toilette is a cheerful, fresh, fun and lively women’s fragrance that literally encapsulates summer. Light Blue opens bright and transparent with a shocking burst of Sicilian lemon, Granny Smith apple, cedar, and soft bellflower akin to the scent of an early cool morning soft breeze; incredibly pleasant! Light Blue has a slight playful nature, while bamboo, jasmine, and rose enhance its buoyancy and elegance. Light Blue dries down smooth and enjoyable with cedarwood, clean musk, and a gentle bit of amber, leaving a subtle but long-lasting impression on your skin.

products.title: Valentino Uomo Born In Roma Coral Fantasy Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: The Valentino Uomo Born In Roma Coral Fantasy Eau De Toilette is a fragrance for men that has a fresh, woody, and slightly spicy scent, and it is modern at the same time. The very first notes of the fragrance are an appealing combination of juicy red apple, cardamom, and bergamot, which are thoroughly delightful and full of liveliness. The heart of the fragrance is clean and very aromatic; it is composed of lavender, geranium, and sage. The base notes are tobacco leaf, patchouli, and vetiver that provide warmth and depth to the fragrance. The fragrance mainly reflects a fashionably young and daring personality, thus making it suitable for everyday wear and informal gatherings.

products.title: Givenchy Gentleman Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Givenchy Gentleman Eau De Parfum for Men is a delightful fragrance that masterfully communicates the spicy and sweet notes in its own classy way. The first impression consists of black pepper, lavender, and bergamot, which provide the freshness, after which the heart notes of orris, cloves, and cinnamon give the warmth. The base consists of the very deep and sophisticated notes of black vanilla husk, tolu balsam, tonka bean, benzoin, and patchouli.

products.title: Ajmal Sacrifice Homme Deodrant
products.body_html: Ajmal Sacrifice II Perfume Deodorant for Men is a captivating fragrance that embodies strength, elegance, and a modern sense of masculinity. This 200ml deodorant offers a long-lasting scent experience, keeping you feeling fresh and confident throughout your day.

products.title: Azzaro Wanted By Night Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Azzaro Wanted By Night Eau De Parfum is a bold, deep, and mysterious fragrance designed for the modern man who lives confidently and makes a strong impression. Launched in 2018, Azzaro Wanted By Night EDP brings a unique blend of spicy cinnamon, fresh citrus, and rich woody notes, making it a perfect scent for evenings, special events, and cooler days.

Wanted By Night Eau De Parfum is intense and sensual, made for those who own the night. With its warm, spicy character and deep masculine vibe, Azzaro Wanted By Night is often described as charismatic and seductive, ideal for parties, dates, and night outs.

products.title: Al Haramain L'aventure Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Al Haramain L'aventure Eau De Parfum is a fresh, confident, and magnetic fragrance for the modern man who loves adventure. This perfume is an amazing blend of fresh citrus, rich woods, and warm musk that creates a memorable scent experience. It smells like success and confidence in a bottle.

L'aventure is incredibly versatile and loved for its ability to draw compliments. It’s perfect for the man who wants a signature scent that is both energetic and elegant. One spray of Al Haramain L'aventure makes you feel ready to conquer the day, whether you're in a business meeting or on a weekend trip.

products.title: Khadlaj Azure Velvet Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Khadlaj Azure Velvet Extrait de Parfume is a fresh and smooth citrus perfume that is applied by women and men. The initial spray is a cool blend of bergamot, lavender and mint that is refreshing and invigorating. It has slow, soft, fruity, and flowery notes coming in slowly, giving it a touch of light sweetness. Woody notes, powdery accords and incense form a cool, slightly smoky, enduring finish that lingers on the skin hours later in the dry down. It is contemporary, stylish, and comfortable to put on at all times.

products.title: Giorgio Armani Profondo Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Giorgio Armani Acqua di Giò Profondo Parfum for men is a fresh and deep ocean-inspired scent that starts with cool marine notes and bright green mandarin, moves to a soft mimosa heart, and ends with earthy patchouli and warm labdanum base. Created in 2024, it's part of the famous Acqua di Giò line, loved for its clean, lasting vibe that feels like a dive into clear blue waters. Many in the fragrance world call it a top pick for its smooth mix of notes, good throw, and easy wear that stands out without being too much.

products.title: Afnan Souvenir Blooming Bliss Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Afnan Souvenir Blooming Bliss Eau de Parfum is a sweet, warm, and dreamy fragrance made for women who love to feel soft and beautiful. Launched in 2024, this perfume brings together creamy vanilla with tropical coconut and delicious caramel for a scent that feels like a warm hug. The gentle touch of Palo Santo adds a hint of calm woodiness, while the base of white musk and sandalwood gives a smooth and cozy finish.

Souvenir Blooming Bliss Eau de Parfum is perfect for women who enjoy fragrances that are sweet yet elegant. Every spray wraps you in a blissful, creamy cloud that lasts for hours and keeps you feeling fresh and confident all day long.

products.title: Lattafa Ana Abiyedh Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Ana Abiyedh Eau De Parfum is a clean, soft, and refreshing unisex scent that feels simple yet very elegant. It opens with bright citrusy notes of bergamot and orange, giving a fresh and uplifting start. In the middle of the fragrance are vanilla and pear, which produce a very smooth and creamy sweetness and are very pleasant to smell. At last, it is the warm musk and amber in the base that make it cozy, last a long time, and are suitable for daily use.

products.title: Calvin Klein Be Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Calvin Klein Be Eau de Toilette is a unisex fragrance that blends fresh, floral, and woody notes to create a calm and natural vibe. Launched in 1996, it opens with a combination of lavender, citrus, and mint for a fresh start. The middle notes have soft floral and green notes like jasmine, peach, and magnolia. The base is warm and comforting with musk, sandalwood, cedar, vanilla, and amber, giving a smooth finish for everyday wear.

products.title: Yves Saint Laurent Myslf Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Yves Saint Laurent Myslf Eau De Parfum is the new-age scent of modern confidence. It’s a fragrance that celebrates being your true self, fresh, clean, and effortlessly stylish. Created for the man who is not afraid to show his sensitive side, this perfume beautifully combines bright citrus with a clean floral heart and a warm, woody base.

YSL Myslf is incredibly versatile and easy to wear. It’s the perfect companion for every part of your day, from a busy morning at the office to a relaxed evening with friends. A spray of Yves Saint Laurent Myslf feels like putting on your favorite crisp shirt, it gives you a boost of freshness and makes you feel put-together and ready for anything.

products.title: Yves Saint Laurent Y Eau de Parfum Intense
products.body_html:
Y Eau de Parfum Intense Yves Saint Laurent for Men is a strong, fresh, and confident fragrance made for the modern man. This new version from the iconic Y collection brings more depth, intensity, and freshness than ever before. It opens with a burst of spicy ginger, fresh bergamot, and lively juniper berries. In the heart, you’ll find aromatic sage, soothing lavender, and elegant geranium, which add a masculine yet clean touch. The base is deep and woody with vetiver, patchouli, and cedar, giving long-lasting strength and warmth.

Y Eau de Parfum Intense Yves Saint Laurent for Men is perfect for men who want to feel powerful, stylish, and ready to take on any challenge. One spray gives you freshness that lasts all day, whether you are in the office, at a party, or on a date night.

products.title: Franck Olivier Oud Vanille Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Franck Olivier Oud Vanille Eau De Parfum is a warm, deep, and cozy smell. It feels rich right from the start. It mixes the smooth sweet of caramel and raspberry with a little fresh orange. This makes a creamy, nice opening. As it sits, the perfume infuses more. You get a flowery smell of rose, violet, and jasmine. This is mixed with patchouli and a bit of incense. It gives a soft, smoky, and mysterious feel. It is creamy, cozy, and a little spicy. It rests nicely on wood, musk, and spice smells. 

Franck Olivier Oud Vanille is the kind of scent that makes you feel wrapped up in luxury. It is not too loud. But people will notice you when you walk past. It is perfect for evenings or cold days. It leaves a sweet, deep smell that stays softly. This perfume is good for both men and women. It balances sweet, spice, and sexy smells well. It is not too strong.

products.title: Hermes Terre D'hermes Eau Givree Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Hermes Terre D’Hermes Eau Givree is a fresh, bright, and cool fragrance that combines citrus with soft woods. It opens with a sharp and icy citron note that feels clean and energising. The middle brings juniper berries and timur pepper, giving a spicy and aromatic touch. As it dries down, the scent turns smooth with mineral and woody notes, making it calm, earthy, and elegant. It feels modern, refreshing, and perfect for men who like a crisp, clean, and classy everyday perfume.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Frost Ice Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Frost Ice Eau de Parfum was launched in 2024 as a light and breezy unisex fragrance with refreshing citrus, bergamot, and mint top notes; aromatic spices, lavender, and geranium heart notes; and soft and warm musk, woods, and amber base notes. A couple of spritz of Frose Ice EDP in the morning keeps you refreshed and energized throughout the day.

products.title: Dunhill Indian Sandalwood Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Dunhill Indian Sandalwood Eau de Parfum is a classic woody fragrance for men. Launched in 2019, it opens with fresh and slightly sweet notes of carrot and bergamot (top notes); moves to a soft and earthy heart of orris and moss (middle notes); and rests on a warm, comforting base of Indian sandalwood, patchouli and cypriol oil (nagarmotha). It is a smooth, elegant scent perfect for daily wear or special occasions.

products.title: Chopard Oud Malaki Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Chopard Oud Malaki Eau De Parfum is a bold men’s fragrance that combines smoky woods, leather, and spices with a warm and deep oud base. This scent shows true luxury and elegance, made for men who love strong and royal perfumes. It starts fresh with grapefruit and lavender, turns deep with tobacco and leather, and finally settles into a base of oud, ambergris, and dark woods that gives a classy and long-lasting scent trail.

products.title: Lattafa Ejaazi Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Ejaazi Eau De Parfum is a creamy, bold and classy scent for both men and women. It mixes fresh citrus and spicy notes with a warm woody base that makes it perfect for all-day wear. The perfume presents a citrus explosion of orange and cardamom, then the sweet patchouli comes along with the hot pepper. The base notes give a thick combination of amber, cedar, vetiver and oakmoss which makes it really charming and powerful.

products.title: Lattafa Maahir Black Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Maahir Black Eau De Parfum is a bold and deep oriental scent made for both men and women. It starts with the spiciness of black pepper, pink pepper and saffron, which are all together giving a powerful and fresh beginning. The middle note combines smoky cade oil with labdanum, balsam and rhubarb for a dark, warm and rich feeling. Finally, the base of smooth leather, cedar, guaiac wood, patchouli, moss and musk creates a fragrant, lasting and classy perfume.

products.title: Lattafa Asad Zanzibar Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Asad Zanzibar Eau de Parfum is a bold and fresh fragrance for men. Launched in 2024 by Lattafa Perfumes, it blends unique spicy, floral, and sweet notes into a smooth, long-lasting scent. The top notes of lavender and black pepper give a fresh and spicy start. The heart notes of coconut water, iris, and salt make it clean and calming. Finally, the base notes of vanilla and incense leave a warm and slightly sweet trail that lasts all day.

products.title: Byredo Bal D'afrique Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Byredo Bal D'Afrique Eau de Parfum is a warm and elegant unisex fragrance inspired by African culture and Parisian spirit. Launched in 2009, this scent beautifully combines citrus, floral, and woody notes in a smooth balance. It opens with fresh Amalfi lemon, marigold, bergamot, black currant, and African orange flower. The middle notes of violet, cyclamen, and jasmine give it a soft floral charm, while the base of vetiver, musk, amber, and Virginia cedar adds depth and long-lasting warmth.

products.title: Boucheron Homme Jaipur Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Boucheron Homme Jaipur Eau De Parfum is a bold, classy, and warm fragrance that speaks of timeless elegance. Inspired by the royal city of Jaipur, this perfume blends zesty citrus, rich spices, and smooth vanilla for a scent that feels both powerful and comforting.

From the very first spray, fresh lemon and lemon verbena awaken your senses with a burst of energy. Soon, the heart reveals warm cinnamon and nutmeg, wrapping you in a spicy embrace. As it settles, creamy vanilla and woody notes create a deep, smooth finish that stays with you for hours.

Boucheron Homme Jaipur Eau De Parfum is perfect for men who love confident, long-lasting fragrances that leave a mark wherever they go. Whether you are at a wedding, a formal dinner, or an evening out, this scent makes sure you’re remembered.

products.title: Givenchy Gentleman Society Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Givenchy Gentleman Society Eau De Parfum is a classic, contemporary and daring perfume for men, a combination of fresh herbs, delicate flowers and deep wood scents. It starts with piquant cardamom and fragrant sage, then develops to the rich heart of French narcissus and the two vetiver notes from Haiti and Madagascar. The base gets warmer with the combination of creamy vanilla, Palo Santo, and smooth cedar. This perfume is powerful, fashionable, and classy – just right for men who love luxury and have a strong personal style.

products.title: Diptyque Orpheon Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Diptyque Orphéon Eau de Parfum is a classy, modern unisex fragrance that feels warm, cozy, and stylish all at once. Inspired by the lively nights of Paris in the 1960s, Orphéon evokes memories of jazz bars, wooden furniture, and powdery notes reminiscent of soft skin and warm drinks.

Diptyque Orphéon Eau de Parfum opens with a fresh, slightly spicy touch of juniper berries, which feels crisp and clean. The heart of jasmine adds a gentle floral note that balances beautifully with the warm base of powder, cedarwood, and smooth tonka bean.

Diptyque Orphéon Eau de Parfum is perfect for people who love fragrances that feel both fresh and comforting. This perfume feels like wearing a stylish blazer with a soft scarf, easy, elegant, and always inviting.

products.title: Calvin Klein All Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Calvin Klein All Eau de Toilette is a fresh unisex fragrance from the house of Calvin Klein. Launched in 2017, it carries the modern spirit of youth and freedom with a clean citrus profile. The perfume opens with a burst of bergamot, mandarin orange, and grapefruit blossom giving a bright and zesty start. The heart notes bring out jasmine, rhubarb, freesia, and lily adding a soft floral touch with a hint of green freshness. Finally, the dry down settles into warm and smooth notes of musk, amber, and vetiver, making it a balanced scent that feels both uplifting and comforting.

products.title: Creed Green Irish Tweed Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Creed Green Irish Tweed EDT for men was launched in 1985 in France by Creed Boutique—a renowned fragrance house in high society. It is a fine blend of fresh green aromas that adds a timeless, sophisticated, and charismatic gentleman vibe to the masculine energy. It gives a clean and polished depth with its aromatic fougère DNA and soft natural notes of iris, vervain, violet leaves, amber, and sandalwood.

products.title: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia Eau de Parfum is a joyful, dreamy, and fresh fragrance for women who love to feel confident, young, and free-spirited. This new perfume is inspired by the beauty of blooming magnolia flowers, mixed with fruity and creamy touches that make you feel happy from the first spray.

Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia is playful yet elegant. The top notes bring juicy dewberry, soft coconut, and a splash of fresh orange. The heart is full of magnolia petals, jasmine sambac, ylang-ylang, and lily of the valley, giving a lovely floral touch. In the base, warm musk, patchouli, and blonde woods make Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia long-lasting and soft.

This fragrance is for women who want to stand out sweetly and freshly, whether at work, on a date, or at a special event. One spray of Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia Eau de Parfum can lift your mood and add a touch of floral magic to your day.

products.title: Creed Aventus Absolu Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Creed Aventus Absolu Eau De Parfum is the boldest, freshest version of the iconic Aventus ever made. It’s a limited-edition fragrance that turns up the volume on the signature Creed DNA making it fruitier, fresher, and even more irresistible. Designed for the man who owns the room with confidence and class, Creed Aventus Absolu blends the juicy brightness of grapefruit and blackcurrant with a refined woody base. The result? A modern, luxurious fragrance that smells powerful, clean, and classy at the same time.

Creed Aventus Absolu is all about making a statement whether you’re heading to a high-profile meeting, a wedding, or just want to feel elite. Every spray feels rich, fresh, and uplifting perfect for Indian men who appreciate sharp, long-lasting luxury.

products.title: Burberry Elixir Eau de Parfum Intense
products.body_html:
Burberry Elixir Eau de Parfum Intense is a bold, addictive, and modern fragrance made for women who love making a statement without saying a word. It opens with the luscious sweetness of ripe strawberries and juicy blackberries, fresh yet indulgent. The heart blooms with creamy jasmine, adding a soft, feminine touch. As it settles, the warmth of vanilla, amber, and sandalwood wraps around you like a cosy, luxurious blanket.

The perfume feels playful yet elegant, perfect for those moments when you want to feel glamorous, confident, and unforgettable. Whether it’s a romantic date night, a party, or a festive gathering, Burberry Elixir Eau de Parfum Intense leaves a trail that turns heads.

products.title: Lattafa Al Qiam Silver Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Al Qiam Eau de Parfum is a beautiful unisex perfume that feels clean, woody, and modern. It opens with a burst of grapefruit and ginger, which gives a bright and spicy freshness. After that, the heart of the perfume is made by ambroxan and sandalwood, giving a slightly warm and soft woody smell. The base consists of musk and vetiver, which produce a warm and earthy dry down that is very close to your skin. It is fresh but deep, ideal for everyday use or special occasions.

products.title: Giorgio Armani Acqua Di Gio Pour Homme Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Giorgio Armani Acqua Di Gio Pour Homme Eau De Parfum for men is a fresh powerful scent perfect for warm days, it starts with cool sea notes and zesty green mandarin, then moves to herbal clary sage lavender and geranium in the heart, finishes with smooth mineral vetiver and patchouli base. Made by Alberto Morillas in 2022. Folks in fragrance circles love it as a modern upgrade to the classic, super clean aquatic vibe with solid staying power and nice reach that feels just right.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Aariz Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Arabiyat Prestige Aariz is a modern, fresh, and exquisite fragrance designed for everyone. It perfectly captures the feeling of a cool, gentle breeze on a warm day. Aariz is a scent that feels both sophisticated and comforting, blending bright, happy notes with a soft, clean heart.

Aariz smells like confidence and charm in a bottle. It has a beautiful freshness that makes it easy to wear, while its rich base gives it a character that is hard to forget. It’s the perfect choice for those who want a signature scent that is unique, versatile, and consistently receives compliments. One spray of Aariz makes you feel polished, modern, and ready for anything.

products.title: Ajmal Wisal Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Ajmal Wisal Eau De Parfum is a soft, elegant, and modern floral fragrance made for today’s confident women. Launched in 2010, Ajmal Wisal Eau De Parfum brings together the timeless beauty of fresh roses, warm spices, creamy sandalwood, and smooth musk. The result is a gentle yet long-lasting perfume that makes you feel fresh, graceful, and feminine all day long.

This beautiful fragrance is perfect for daily wear or for special occasions when you want to feel extra special and noticed. One spray of Ajmal Wisal Eau De Parfum is enough to leave behind a delicate floral trail that feels comforting and classy at the same time.

products.title: Lattafa Ana Abiyedh Leather Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Ana Abiyedh Leather Eau de Parfum is a bold and luxurious unisex fragrance. Introduced in 2017, it literally combines all the notes of the fresh, spicy, and warm fragrance family making the whole composition leather-centric and smooth. The fruity and spicy mix of juniper berries, cardamom, pink pepper, and raspberry marks up the top notes. The middle has the floral and slightly hot scent of iris, ginger, and rose. The bottom or base note is composed of a combination of leather, white musk, and amber, which are rich and sensual thus leaving a long-lasting impression.

products.title: Diptyque Doson Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Do Son Eau de Parfum is a luminous and elegant floral fragrance that captures the beauty of white‑flowers in full bloom. It opens with fresh touches of orange blossom and pink pepper that add a sparkling brightness, then evolves into rich tuberose and jasmine in the heart, and settles on warm musks and benzoin. It is created for both women and men who love refined, floral scents that feel both clean and seductive.

products.title: Ajmal Avid Homme Deodrant
products.body_html: This perfume has a highly intense fragrance that attracts the young, suave male audience. The fragrance pools a wide range of fresh and heartening notes. The top notes carry fresh and fruity tones, merging into a woody aquatic heart that exudes an enlivening effect on the wearer. The top and heart culminate into a fascinating base, full of warm amber and patchouli to make the creation cast its charm.

products.title: Lattafa Musamam Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Musamam Eau de Parfum is a bold unisex perfume made for those who love creamy and deep scents. It starts with a warm mix of saffron, lavender and fresh Italian mandarin that brings brightness and spice together. The heart opens with amberwood, cedar and geranium giving it a woody and slightly floral feel. The base of akigalawood, incense and labdanum adds smoky warmth that stays on skin for long hours.

products.title: Burberry My Burberry Blush Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Burberry My Burberry Blush Eau de Parfum is a bright, lively, and feminine fragrance that feels like a fresh morning in a blooming English garden. It’s playful yet elegant, the perfect mix for women who love feeling confident, happy, and graceful.

Created by the world-famous perfumer Francis Kurkdjian, this scent opens with the sparkling freshness of pomegranate and lemon, bringing an instant burst of energy. The heart unfolds with green apple, delicate rose petals, and soft geranium, adding a romantic, floral sweetness. Finally, it settles into a dreamy base of wisteria and jasmine, leaving a soft, lingering trail that feels fresh all day.

Burberry My Burberry Blush Eau de Parfum is like wearing your favourite floral dress on a sunny day, uplifting, elegant, and effortlessly charming.

products.title: Calvin Klein DEFY Parfum
products.body_html: Calvin Klein Defy Parfum is a woody aromatic fragrance designed for men who love deep and daring scents. It was launched in 2023 and created by perfumer Pascal Gaurin. The perfume starts with spicy pink pepper and is followed by the calming and fresh touch of lavender then dries down to a unique warm base of cacao. The mix gives a balance of spicy, floral and gourmand notes making it a modern perfume for men.

products.title: Armaf Ventana Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Armaf Ventana Eau de Parfum is a modern men’s fragrance from the house of Armaf. Launched in 2017, it is a fresh yet deep scent that combines citrus and woody tones beautifully. The perfume opens with a shot of grapefruit, lemon, and mandarin orange. The middle brings calming lavender, geranium, vetiver, and patchouli, while the base settles into amber, sandalwood, cedar, and precious woods. It is a bold, energetic fragrance that gives a classy vibe for all-day wear.

products.title: Dunhill  Icon Racing Blue Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Dunhill Icon Racing Blue Eau de Parfum is a fresh and masculine perfume for men. Launched in 2021, it opens with zesty and fresh top notes of lime, bergamot and ambroxan, followed by spicy and aquatic notes of sea salt, cardamom, neroli and coriander. The base notes of driftwood, ambergris, sandalwood and patchouli give it a warm and woody finish.

products.title: Carolina Herrera 212 VIP Black Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Carolina Herrera 212 VIP Black Eau De Parfum is a bold men’s fragrance made for the party spirit. Released in 2017, this scent mixes strong spicy, herbal and sweet notes into a modern aromatic fougere blend. The fragrance opens with absinthe, anise, and fennel for a sharp and spicy start. Lavender in the heart brings balance and freshness. In the base, black vanilla husk and musk add a dark, sensual touch that lasts long on the skin. It is daring, masculine and smooth perfect for evening events and night outs.

products.title: Diptyque Kyoto Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Diptyque Kyoto Eau de Parfum is a soft, earthy floral fragrance inspired by Japanese culture and Ikebana, the art of flower arranging. Created by perfumer Alexandra Carlin, it blends the fresh, slightly sweet aroma of Turkish rose with earthy beetroot and deep smoky vetiver, balanced with a layer of incense. It's a calm, minimal, and artistic scent almost meditative in its personality, perfect for those who enjoy quiet elegance and nature-inspired perfumes.

products.title: Burberry London Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Burberry London Eau de Parfum is a classic floral scent that exudes elegance and timeless appeal. Launched in 2006, this fragrance opens with sweet honeysuckle, fresh tangerine, and soft rose (top notes), followed by jasmine, tiare flower, peony, and clementine (middle notes) and finishes with warm musk, sandalwood, and patchouli (base notes). A perfect combination of freshness, florals, and warmth makes it one of the most loved Burberry perfumes for women.

products.title: Lattafa Art of Nature 1 Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Art of Nature Eau de Parfum is a luxurious unisex scent that blends the magic of nature with rich oriental notes. Launched in 2024, this perfume carries the freshness of fruits and the depth of woody warmth. It starts with figs, plums, and blackcurrants, which are of the best quality and then very slowly dissolve into the gentle center of leather, rhubarb, and rose. The base holds deep oud, smooth ambergris, and creamy vanilla, leaving an elegant and long-lasting trail on your skin.

products.title: Ard Al Zaafaran Dirham Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Ard Al Zaafaran Dirham Oud Eau De Parfum special fragrance is perfect for both men and women who love a warm, woody scent with a touch of elegance. Dirham Oud is a beautiful combination of fresh notes and deep, earthy tones, creating a perfume that feels both modern and classic.

This fragrance is a journey for your senses. It starts with a bright and zesty burst of fruits, then moves to a soft floral heart, and finally settles into a powerful, lasting base of woods and oud. It's a scent that makes you feel confident and sophisticated, perfect for any occasion where you want to make a statement.

products.title: Louis Vuitton Symphony Extrait de Parfum
