products.body_html: Louis Vuitton Symphony Extrait de Parfum is a women's and men's citrus fragrance, released in 2021 and developed by Jacques Cavallier Belletrud. It starts with a powerful, juicy note of grapefruit that is refreshing and invigorating. The smell remains pure, silky and luxurious on the skin. It is an extract that is long-lasting and feels richer than an ordinary fresh perfume, which is best worn in summer and during the day.

products.title: Armaf Odyssey White Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Armaf Odyssey White Eau de Parfum is a men’s fragrance from the popular house of Armaf it starts with spicy pink pepper, citrus yuzu and fresh grapefruit that give an energetic start and in the middle violet leaf and sea notes add a soft, clean and slightly green touch. The end notes are warm and woody with amber, amberwood and guaiac wood making it a balanced everyday perfume. It feels refreshing, youthful and modern perfect for men who like a combination of freshness with warmth.

products.title: Lancome La Vie Est Belle Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: The Lancome La Vie Est Belle Eau De Parfum is a sweet and cheerful fragrance perfectly made for women. The opening notes reveal fresh blackcurrant and delightful pear that are light and fruity at the same time. The middle notes of iris, jasmine, and orange blossom give the fragrance a smooth and elegant touch with soft floral notes. The warm and comforting base composed of praline, vanilla, patchouli, and tonka bean also contributes to the fragrance being long-lasting and suitable for women who adore sweet, elegant, and happy scents.

products.title: Dumont Nitro Green Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Dumont Nitro Green Eau de Parfum is a fresh, green and woody scent made for men who like strong but clean fragrance. It opens with sweet notes of vanilla, saffron and jasmine that give a soft and rich start. In the heart, you get lavender, amberwood, green leaves and cedar that make it calm, smooth, and classy. The dry down is deep and earthy with violet, fir resin and cedar that stay warm on skin for hours.

products.title: Dumont Nitro Black Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Dumont Nitro Black Eau de Parfum is a bold and modern men’s fragrance that mixes freshness with deep woody warmth. It opens with a burst of fruity notes, pineapple, bergamot, black currant and apple that give a clean and bright start. The nature of the scent turns richer with pepper, birch, patchouli, jasmine, lavender and rose, adding spice and class. In the end, musk, amber and vanilla create a smooth and comforting base that lasts long.

products.title: Azzaro Chrome Legend Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Azzaro Chrome Legend Eau De Toilette is a fresh fragrance for men. Launched in 2007, it mixes fruity, aromatic, and woody notes into a smooth and lively scent. The perfume opens with crisp green apple and bitter orange, giving a fresh and bright start. Its heart is warm with tea and subtle spices, while the base brings a masculine touch of musk, tonka bean, vetiver, cedar, oakmoss, and amber. Chrome Legend is a perfect mix of freshness and depth for everyday wear.

products.title: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Blush Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Blush Eau de Parfum is a soft and romantic version of the iconic Good Girl line. Released in 2023, this fragrance brings a playful and feminine twist to the collection. It opens with the freshness of bergamot and almond, moving into a floral heart of peony and ylang-ylang. The base finishes with creamy vanilla and sweet coumarin, making the scent both warm and delicate. This perfume captures elegance, charm, and modern femininity in a light pink stiletto bottle that is as attractive as the fragrance inside.

products.title: Franck Olivier Blue Touch Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Franck Olivier Blue Touch Eau De Toilette is a fresh scent. It feels like you’re standing right by the ocean. But there's a nice woody accent mixed in too. It came out in 2011. It has a bright, zesty opening. You get a big rush of lemon, bergamot, green leaves, tangerine, and a small hint of pink pepper. It feels like a sunny morning. The middle section is cool and deep. This gives it a manly feel. That comes from melon, patchouli, vetiver, wood smells, sage, and galbanum. In the end, it gets warm. You get a lingering fresh scent from musk, oakmoss, and amber. This fragrance is for men who like clean, fresh, and maybe slightly spicy smells.

products.title: Calvin Klein DEFY Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Calvin Klein DEFY Eau de Parfum is a bold men’s fragrance that was launched in 2022 this scent brings a confident balance of fresh spice, smooth leather and earthy wood. The fragrance opens with a spark of Mandarin Orange and black pepper giving a bright yet spice start and the middle with saffiano leather and suede adding a refined and daring tone and at the base Haitian Vetiver anchors the scent with depth and power. It is made for men who like to break limits and show their fearless side.

products.title: Penhaligon's Halfeti Leather Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Penhaligon's Halfeti Leather Eau de Parfum is a powerful and mysterious leather scent that is unisex. The fragrance begins with a delicate combination of plum, cardamom, and fresh citrus that is warm and somewhat spicy. Gradually, rose, nutmeg, and cinnamon unfold revealing a profound and elegant character. At the end of the process, leather, oud, and incense remain robust and smoky. The impression received from this fragrance is dauntless, sumptuous and just right for self-assured perfume users.

products.title: Lattafa Oud Mood Reminiscence Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Oud Mood Reminiscence Eau De Parfum is a warm oriental scent with a bright fruity opening and a smooth woody base. It starts with fresh notes of bergamot, apple and pineapple that feel clean and juicy. Then rose, birch, patchouli and Moroccan jasmine delight you with a floral & smoky quality. Finally, musk, oakmoss, vanilla, and ambergris create a warm soft cloud that remains on the skin like a cozy and gentle hug.

products.title: Bvlgari Le Gemme Tygar Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Bvlgari Le Gemme Tygar Eau De Parfum is a bold and fresh men’s fragrance from the luxury house of Bvlgari. Launched in 2016, this perfume is inspired by the power of the Tiger’s Eye stone, symbolising strength and confidence. The fragrance opens with the brightness of grapefruit, combining into spicy and musky tones of ginger and ambrette, and settles into a smooth base of ambroxan, musk, vetiver, and patchouli. A perfect scent for men who love a fresh, strong, and modern aroma.

products.title: Giorgio Armani Code Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Giorgio Armani Code EDT for men is a fresh seductive scent with bright green mandarin top, clean lavender heart, warm tonka bean cedar base. It came out in 2023, made refillable with sustainable ingredients. People in the fragrance world love it as the modern take on seduction, clean yet warm, great for guys who want to smell put together, nice trail and lasting power.

products.title: Armaf Legesi Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Armaf Legesi Eau de Parfum is the signature scent for the modern man who is confident, sharp, and successful. This fresh and elegant fragrance is designed to make you feel clean and put-together from morning meetings to evening outings. It captures a timeless, classic
charm with a modern twist, making it the perfect everyday companion.Legesi smells incredibly sophisticated and clean. It’s a scent that draws compliments without being loud, creating an aura of professionalism and class. A spray of Armaf Legesi is like putting on a freshly ironed white shirt and a perfectly tailored blazer, it completes your look and prepares you to conquer the day with style.

products.title: Afnan Supremacy Tapis Rouge Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Afnan Supremacy Tapis Rouge Eau de Parfum is a fresh, elegant, and charming fragrance for women who love to feel confident and graceful. Launched in 2024, this beautiful scent is like wearing a fruity-floral silk dress that turns heads wherever you go. Supremacy Tapis Rouge blends juicy fruits with soft florals, creating a modern perfume that feels playful yet classy.

A single spray of Afnan Supremacy Tapis Rouge Eau de Parfum wraps you in a sweet burst of black cherry and litchi, balanced with white peach and a heart of blooming roses and jasmine. The dry down brings a warm touch of vetiver, cloves, and soft peony, making the scent smooth, clean, and feminine. It’s a lovely daily signature for women who love fruity scents with a floral twist.

products.title: Nusuk Eshq Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Nusuk Eshq Eau de Parfum is a soft, sweet and soothing unisex scent from Nusuk Fragrances. It is known for its smooth feel and pleasant, not too sharp or too light, smell. The scent opens with a gentle, sweet tone, then slowly reveals floral and warm notes, finally settling into a creamy, woody base.

products.title: Bvlgari Aqva Pour Homme Eau De Toilette
products.body_html:
Bvlgari Aqva Pour Homme Eau De Toilette is a fresh, masculine fragrance inspired by the deep blue sea and the energy of ocean waves. It’s a scent that feels clean, refreshing, and full of life, perfect for men who want to smell crisp and confident all day.

The fragrance opens with a burst of juicy mandarin and orange, blended with the green freshness of petitgrain. At the heart, unique marine notes of seaweed meet soft lavender and cotton flower, giving it a cool yet sophisticated vibe. The base brings warmth and depth with Virginia cedar, patchouli, clary sage, and amber, making it long-lasting and memorable.

Bvlgari Aqva Pour Homme is like stepping out of the ocean on a sunny day, fresh, cool, and effortlessly stylish. It’s perfect for men who want a clean signature scent for daily wear.

products.title: Maison Margiela Replica Beach Walk Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Maison Margiela Replica Beach Walk Eau De Toilette is a soft, sunny and fresh scent that reminds you of a warm day at the beach. It opens with citrus notes, has a middle of creamy coconut and ends with a subtle musky base. The perfume has a very light, airy, and comfortable feel.

products.title: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Orchid Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Gucci Flora Gorgeous Orchid Eau de Parfum is a dreamy, modern floral perfume designed for the confident woman who loves sweetness with a touch of freshness. Inspired by the beauty of the exotic vanilla orchid, this fragrance mixes delicious vanilla with soft floral notes and a light, airy finish.

Wearing Gucci Flora Gorgeous Orchid feels like stepping into a magical garden filled with blooming orchids and a sweet breeze. It’s elegant, youthful, and perfect for women who want to feel fresh yet luxurious every day.

products.title: Givenchy L'interdit Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Givenchy L'Interdit Eau De Parfum for women is a bold, elegant, and modern floral perfume that brings a creamy white floral vibe with a warm and slightly dark twist. It opens with juicy pear and fresh bergamot, then moves into a rich mix of tuberose, jasmine sambac, and orange blossom for a bright and feminine floral heart. The base offers patchouli, vanilla, vetiver, and ambroxan, giving the scent a soft creamy finish with a deep warm touch.
This perfume is loved for its classy feel, long lasting performance, and confident aura that makes it perfect for women who like to stand out in a graceful way.

products.title: Creed Viking Cologne Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Creed Viking Cologne EDP for men is a bold and invigorating fragrance inspired by strength and adventure. It opens with fresh and zesty top notes of mandarin orange, lemon, pink pepper, and bergamot. The heart blends aromatic lavender, geranium, rosemary, sage, and nutmeg, creating a dynamic and spicy character. The base settles into warm and earthy notes of vetiver, cedar, sandalwood, olibanum, and patchouli, giving it depth and lasting power. Viking Cologne is admired in the fragrance community for its balanced blend of citrus, spices, and woods, offering good projection and longevity.

products.title: Creed Silver Mountain Water Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Creed Silver Mountain Water EDP is a fresh and clean fragrance for men and women. It opens with bright and sparkling top notes of bergamot and mandarin orange. The middle notes gives a refreshing green tea and black currant feel, soft and calming. The base adds depth with musk, sandalwood, petitgrain, and galbanum giving it a smooth and lasting scent. It is loved for being light, elegant, and easy to wear daily while still feeling special and luxurious.

products.title: Bentley Black Edition Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Bentley For Men Black Edition Eau de Parfum is a bold and classy men’s fragrance from the luxury house of Bentley. Launched in 2018, this scent is built on an oriental spicy DNA. It opens with a fresh and slightly sweet touch of violet, tangerine, pink pepper, and nutmeg. The heart is deeper with papyrus, earthy notes, jasmine, patchouli, and a smooth sweetness. The base is warm and masculine, with atlas cedar, moss, incense, tobacco, and tonka bean creating a rich finish that stays long and feels powerful yet elegant.

products.title: Louis Vuitton On The Beach Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Louis Vuitton On The Beach Eau De Parfum is a fresh, bright and uplifting unisex scent inspired by warm sunshine and calm sea breeze. It mixes sparkling citrus with soft floral and warm herbal notes that feel clean, salty and smooth on the skin. The blend opens with juicy yuzu and sweet neroli, then moves into a warm mix of rosemary, thyme, sand, pink pepper and clove. The dry down settles nicely with cypress, giving a green and airy vibe that feels like standing close to the ocean shore.

products.title: Creed Royal Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Creed Royal Oud EDP is made for men and women. This perfume is a sophisticated perfume with a spicy and citrusy start moving into warm and woody middle notes and finishing with an elegant base. It opens with top notes of pink pepper, lemon and Sicilian bergamot which give a fresh and amazing impression. The middle notes of cedar, angelica and galbanum add a woody and green touch while the base of sandalwood, agarwood and musk leaves a smooth and long-lasting scent on skin and clothes.

products.title: Calvin Klein Euphoria Intense Eau De Parfum For Women
products.body_html: Calvin Klein Euphoria Intense Eau De Parfum for women is a modern, rich and seductive fragrance that was launched in 2021. It is a darker and more intense version of the original Euphoria. The perfume combines fruity freshness with sensual floral and woody notes, creating a bold statement for confident women. The composition opens with juicy black currant (top note), moves into exotic orchid (middle note), and dries down with deep earthy patchouli (base note).

products.title: Boss Bottled Night Eau de Toilette
products.body_html:
Boss Bottled Night Eau de Toilette is the confident man’s secret weapon for evenings. Designed for the man who knows how to own the night, this fragrance combines fresh aromatic notes with a smooth woody base that leaves a lasting impression.

It opens with crisp lavender and fresh birch, giving an energetic yet refined feel. The heart reveals soft violet, adding elegance and charm. Finally, deep woody notes and musk create a warm, masculine base that lingers till late.

Boss Bottled Night Eau de Toilette is the perfect scent for dinner dates, evening parties, or any time you want to look and feel powerful. One spray can instantly make you feel more attractive and self-assured.

products.title: Tom Ford Tobacco Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Tobacco Oud Eau de Parfum is a profound, shadowy, and mighty aroma that imparts richness and smokiness. At the top, a powerful whiskey accord is the major player, giving a daring and alcoholic accent first. Gradually, spicy resins like cinnamon and coriander join in and heat things up. When it comes to the base note, the combination of tobacco and oud with incense and different types of woods results in a thick and opulent scent. This fragrance is bold, strong, and sophisticated at the same time and is made for those who like strong and adult-like perfumes.

products.title: Givenchy Givenchy Organza Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Givenchy Organza Eau De Parfum for women is a warm, elegant, and sensual fragrance that is classic and feminine. The first notes are spicy nutmeg, fresh bergamot, sweet gardenia, and soft flowers, then it is rich heart comprising tuberose, jasmine, iris, honeysuckle, and peony. The drydown is a mix of vanilla, amber, cedarwood, guaiac wood, and soft woods making it creamy and deep. The fragrance is described as a timeless scent with a smooth sweet and floral blend, which is ideal for women who prefer a bold but elegant perfume.

products.title: Giorgio Armani Stronger With You Eau De Toilette For Men
products.body_html: Giorgio Armani Stronger With You Eau De Toilette For Men is that sweet, spicy hug in a bottle you spray when you wanna feel warm and loved. It starts with a nutty chestnut and sugary pop that smells like dessert, then rolls into sage and lavender for a clean herbal twist. Vanilla and a smoky edge finish it off cozy and smooth. Cecile Matton whipped this up in 2017 as the guy side of a love duo, all about real, modern romance. It mixes sweet treats with fresh herbs, easy for everyday but special enough to get noticed, with a trail that sticks around just right.

products.title: Diptyque Lilyphea Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Diptyque Lilyphea is a fragrance that evokes the peaceful feel of a water‑lily pond at dawn. With violet leaf creating a fresh green shimmer, the gentle spice of cardamom and ginger adds lift, and the soft warmth of bourbon vanilla provides comfort and elegance. The result is subtle yet refined, a nature‑inspired scent that feels serene and modern. According to Diptyque, the fragrance captures the spirit of the water lily leaf — crisp, sap‑filled, soft.

products.title: Bentley Silverlake Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Bentley For Men Silverlake Eau De Parfum is a fresh, modern, and masculine fragrance that captures the spirit of adventure. Inspired by clear mountain air and sparkling lakes, this scent combines crisp citrus with cool aromatic notes, creating an energising and refreshing experience.

The fragrance opens with a shot of zesty lemon and cool mint, instantly boosting your freshness. At its heart, violet leaves, lavender, and pink pepper add a clean, slightly spicy, and green touch, making it both elegant and sporty. The base of white musk and amberwood brings a smooth, warm, and long-lasting finish.

Bentley For Men Silverlake Eau De Parfum exudes a classy yet casual charm, perfect for the man who appreciates both sophistication and the great outdoors. One spray is like stepping into a crisp morning by a mountain lake, surrounded by fresh air and endless horizons.

products.title: BDK Citrus Riviera Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: BDK Citrus Riviera Eau de Parfum is a fresh unisex perfume from the French perfume house BDK Parfums which was launched in 2020 this fragrance is made by perfumer Ralf Schewieger and captures the joy of the Mediterranean summers. It opens with Italian lemon, neroli, Italian mandarin and fig that give a juicy citrus and the middle notes bring green notes, watery touches, eucalyptus, orange blossom, strawberry, immortelle and jasmine which together feel airy and refreshing. The base is warm and grounding with Haitian vetiver, white musk, tonka bean and Indonesian patchouli leaf making it a smooth combination of fresh and woody accords.

products.title: Armani Prive Rose D'arabie Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Armani Prive Rose D'arabie Eau De Parfum is a luxurious unisex perfume from Armani Prive. Launched in 2010, it is a creamy oriental floral fragrance that combines classic Middle Eastern ingredients with a modern elegance. The scent opens with fresh rose and floral notes, moves to middle notes of agarwood and patchouli, and finishes with warm vanilla for a sensual, lasting impression. It’s perfect for people who love strong, elegant, and sophisticated perfumes.

products.title: Jo Malone Wood Sage & Sea Salt Cologne
products.body_html: Jo Malone Wood Sage & Sea Salt Cologne is a light and fresh perfume that gives a natural and soothing feeling. It starts off with a gentle salty wind that is blended with citrus, giving an overall clean and laid-back impression. As it gradually fades away, the sage scent adds a warm and comforting feeling through an earthy, herbal touch on the skin. The combination of ambrette and seaweed provides a soft, slightly musky foundation reminiscent of a stroll by the seaside. This fragrance is ideal for those who prefer refreshing, natural-scented perfumes.

products.title: Elizabeth Arden Green Tea Scent Spray Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Elizabeth Arden Green Tea Scent Spray Eau De Parfum was launched in 1999. This citrus aromatic fragrance for women is an absolute favourite of working and easy-going women. Francis Kurkdijian is the perfumer behind this absolute fragrance. The top notes of this scent include Lemon, Bergamot, Mint, Orange Peel and Rhubarb. While the heart tones and the dried tones include Jasmine, Musk, Oakmoss, Fennel, Carnation, White Amber, Musk, Oakmoss, Celery Seeds, Caraway, Cloves and Amber.

products.title: Franck Olivier Night Touch Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Franck Olivier Night Touch Eau De Toilette is really smooth, and nice. It smells fresh, warm, and kinda mysterious all at the same time. When you first spray Night Touch, you get a bright smell of bergamot, pineapple, and cardamom - that’s a clean and energetic start. After a bit, you smell flowery and spicy stuff like geranium, nutmeg, and violet that makes Night Touch nice and balanced. The last smell you get is a rich, manly one with patchouli, musk, and amber that stays softly on your skin for a long time.

products.title: Dolce & Gabbana Intenso Pour Homme Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Dolce & Gabbana Intenso Pour Homme Eau de Parfum is a deep, elegant, and modern fragrance for men who like to stand out without trying too hard. Intenso Pour Homme is all about pure instinct, a strong, masculine scent that balances rich, woody notes with fresh green touches.

This fragrance opens with fresh basil and watery notes that feel clean and sharp. In the heart, a unique blend of lavender, tobacco, and hay gives Dolce & Gabbana Intenso Pour Homme a warm and slightly sweet feel. The base is where it gets deep and classy, with sandalwood, amber, labdanum, and musk giving a strong, long-lasting finish.

Dolce & Gabbana Intenso Pour Homme Eau de Parfum is perfect for the modern Indian man who wants to feel confident, sophisticated, and ready to leave a strong impression wherever he goes.

products.title: Byredo Black Saffron Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Byredo Black Saffron Eau de Parfum is a perfume for both men and women. It feels warm, a bit mysterious, and very rich when you wear it. The perfume is inspired by saffron, which is a very special spice. It has a combination of sweet, spicy, and earthy smell that make it bold but still very elegant.

The perfume start with saffron, juniper berries and fresh citrus from Chinese grapefruit, giving a spicy and bright opening. In the middle, you get soft leather and gentle black violet that add some depth and floral touch. Later it settle down into raspberry, cashmeran and vetiver, which give a woody, musky and little sweet finish that stay for long.

products.title: Boss Bottled Elixir Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Boss Bottled Elixir Eau de Parfum is a bold, magnetic, and modern fragrance for men who want to make a lasting impression. As the most intense version in the Boss Bottled line, this scent takes the iconic DNA and turns it into a richer, deeper, and more luxurious experience.

From the very first spray, Boss Bottled Elixir feels powerful yet smooth opening with the spicy freshness of cardamom and the smoky elegance of frankincense. As it develops, earthy patchouli and vetiver step in, adding depth and masculinity. Finally, warm labdanum and dry cedarwood create a strong, long-lasting base that feels sophisticated and confident.

This is not just a fragrance, Boss Bottled Elixir is a statement of strength and charisma. Whether for an important meeting, a date night, or a grand celebration, this scent makes sure all eyes are on you.

products.title: Neesh Glazed Water Extrait De Parfum
products.body_html: Neesh Glazed Water Extrait De Parfum is a fresh, clean and modern aquatic scent made for men who like a cool and classy smell. It starts with bright marine and citrus notes that are like a gentle sea breeze on the skin, turning spicy and soft gradually and finally, warm woody notes dominate the dry down. Due to the extrait concentration, the perfume feels light, refreshing and yet strong.

products.title: Frederic Malle Musc Ravageur Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Frederic Malle Musc Ravageur EDP is a bold, truly sensual choice. It works for everyone—men and women. The scent is famous for its warm, spicy, and deep musk feel. Maurice Roucel created Musc Ravageur in 2000. It opens with fresh energy. You first smell lavender, tangerine, and bergamot. That clean burst soon fades. The center quickly moves to a rich mix: cinnamon, cloves, and rose. This makes the perfume smooth. It gives a light, powdery touch. The base is where it locks down. Expect deep warmth here. Musk, vanilla, amber, and woods dominate. This strong finish makes Musc Ravageur unforgettable. It feels cozy; it feels mysterious. The scent is known for staying warm and strong on your skin all day.

products.title: Franck Boclet Tobacco Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Franck Boclet Tobacco Eau De Parfum is a robust, warm fragrance that feels incredibly cozy and almost addictive. It opens with a smooth blend of tobacco, juicy plum, and spicy ginger, leading to a smoky yet fruity beginning. As the fragrance evolves, you find a rich heart of cloves, creamy tonka bean, and dry cedarwood that adds a depth of richness and texture. The base wraps itself in warm vanilla, benzoin, and earthy vetiver and leaves a soft sweetness with just a gentle smokiness after the dry down.

products.title: Givenchy Gentleman Eau de Toilette Intense
products.body_html: Givenchy Gentleman Eau de Toilette Intense is a classy and alluring scent specifically for the contemporary man who appreciates being bold with a little gentle touch. The fragrance starts off with a combination of cardamom, basil, and bergamot that is both bright and classy. The middle of perfume contains a soft and delicate scent of iris flowers together with a fresh and clean scent of cypress, which contributes to the overall smoothness and purity. The warm and soothing finish of cedar and coumarin forms the base of the fragrance which is at the same time soft and detectable. This perfume is a beautiful fusion of power and elegance; thus, it can be worn either in the daytime or for a quiet night out.

products.title: Creed Virgin Island Water Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Creed Virgin Island Water Eau de Parfum is a bright and tropical unisex perfume that captures the fresh breeze of the Caribbean islands. The creators, Olivier Creed and Erwin Creed, introduced this perfume in 2007. With lime, coconut, and rum being the primary notes of this scent, it takes you to a sunny beach in an instant. The smoothness and refreshing of the holiday mood that this fragrance brings can be enjoyed by anyone who loves to smell beachy and feel-good scents.

products.title: Creed Royal Mayfair Eau de Parfum (2024)
products.body_html:
Creed Royal Mayfair Eau de Parfum is a bold, classy, and refreshing fragrance made for royalty and for those who live like one. Inspired by the Duke of Windsor and the upscale Mayfair district in London, this scent feels luxurious, clean, and crisp. It perfectly blends aromatic, floral, and green notes with a soft woody base to create a refined signature scent.

Creed Royal Mayfair smells like confidence in a bottle. It starts fresh and sharp, thanks to British gin and lime, and then flows into sweet rose and smooth eucalyptus, finishing with soft cedarwood. Whether you’re heading to a formal dinner, an office meeting, or a classy brunch, Royal Mayfair will leave a polished and sophisticated impression.

products.title: Burberry London Eau de Toilette
products.body_html:
Burberry London Eau de Toilette for Men is the perfect combination of British charm and timeless elegance. This fragrance captures the spirit of London, warm, classy, and effortlessly stylish. It opens with the freshness of bergamot and lavender, wrapped in the comforting spice of cinnamon. As it settles, rich leather and soft mimosa create a smooth, masculine heart, leading to a deep base of tobacco leaf, guaiac wood, oakmoss, and opoponax.

Burberry London Eau de Toilette feels like stepping into a cosy, high-end London gentleman’s club warm wood, leather chairs, and a touch of tobacco in the air. It’s sophisticated yet approachable, making it perfect for men who want to stand out with elegance.

products.title: Riiffs Samah Pearl Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Samah Pearl Extrait de Parfum is a tender, sweet and touch spicy female perfume that is rich and contemporary in its touch and feel. The introduction is sweet and crisp with plump rambutan and grapefruit with a touch of cardamom. Bulgarian rose and peony make their appearance in the heart with a touch of romantic floral flavour sprinkled with blackcurrant sweetness. Caramel and incense base is creamy, warm and a bit smoky and thus long-lasting and elegant. This perfume is feminine, self-confident, and suitable for those women who admire sweet flowers with a warm touch.

products.title: Bentley Intense For Men Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Bentley Intense For Men Eau de Parfum is a luxurious fragrance made for confident men which was Launched in 2013, it opens with spicy and fresh top notes of black pepper, bay leaf, and bergamot. The middle notes bring a combination of rum, woody notes, cinnamon, clary sage, and African geranium. Finally, the base settles into deep and warm notes of incense, leather, benzoin, cedar, and patchouli, creating a long-lasting masculine scent.

products.title: Creed Original Vetiver Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Creed Original Vetiver Eau de Parfum is a fresh, clean, and sophisticated fragrance that captures the green spirit of nature with a luxurious twist. Unlike traditional vetiver scents that use only the root, Creed uses the entire vetiver plant, leaves, roots, and heartwood, resulting in a smooth, earthy, and uplifting scent.

This unisex fragrance feels elegant yet sporty, perfect for people who love refreshing yet long-lasting perfumes. It opens with a crisp green burst and gradually melts into warm, woody softness. Creed Original Vetiver is ideal for anyone who wants to smell fresh, refined, and put-together throughout the day.

products.title: Ariana Grande Sweet Like Candy Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Ariana Grande Sweet Like Candy Eau De Parfum is a delightfully playful and flirty fragrance that is as charming as its name. This scent is a candy-lover's dream, bottling the feeling of pure joy and irresistible sweetness. It’s designed for the woman who is fun-loving, confident, and loves to express her sweet side.

Sweet Like Candy smells like a delicious treat you can wear. It has a youthful, happy, and vibrant charm that is perfect for everyday wear. A single spray of Ariana Grande's Sweet Like Candy will wrap you in a cloud of sugary bliss, making you feel cheerful and irresistible.

products.title: Creed Millesime Imperial Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Creed Millésime Impérial Eau de Parfum is a fresh, elegant, and timeless fragrance that captures the spirit of coastal luxury and warm sunshine. Created by the House of Creed in 1995, this iconic scent is loved by both men and women for its clean, citrusy freshness with a smooth musky finish.

Creed Millésime Impérial Eau de fragrance opens with a burst of juicy fruits and sea breeze, making you feel like you’re walking along a royal Mediterranean coast. As it develops, warm woods and musk add depth and sophistication, making it a perfect choice for those who want a scent that’s both refreshing and classy.

Creed Millésime Impérial is a fragrance that fits every season and every occasion. Whether it’s a sunny day, a romantic evening, or a formal event, this perfume makes you feel confident, clean, and irresistible.

products.title: Burberry Brit For Her Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Burberry Brit For Her Eau De Parfum is a sweet, fresh, and playful fragrance that feels like a cosy hug on a winter morning. It blends juicy fruits, soft flowers, and warm, creamy notes to create a scent that is charming yet comforting.

The fragrance opens with a burst of fresh lime, sweet pear, and a hint of almond. Soon, the heart reveals a beautiful mix of candied almond, sugar, and soft peony flowers, making it both sweet and romantic. As it dries down, warm vanilla, tonka bean, amber, and mahogany wood wrap you in a smooth, cosy finish.

Burberry Brit For Her is perfect for women who love a feminine scent that is both casual and classy. It’s the kind of perfume that makes you feel confident and beautiful without being too loud.

products.title: Fragrance World Urban Man Paradise Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Fragrance world Urban Man Paradise Eau de Parfum is a new and contemporary male fragrance, which appears to be daring and assertive. It begins with a very fresh puff of citrus and green that are refreshing and invigorating, and proceeds to a warm and spicy core that makes it rich and nuanced. The foundation of soft woods provides a durable soft touch that takes a long time to leave the skin. This fragrance is ideal to men who prefer fresh, contemporary, and confident smells and can be worn during the day as well as nat ight.

products.title: Franck Olivier Pure Addiction Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Franck Olivier Pure Addiction Eau De Parfum is a really smooth, warm, and mysterious smell. It feels modern but also comforting, you know? It starts with a soft, fresh burst of orange, that gives Pure Addiction a clean and welcoming start. After a bit, you smell saffron, marigold, and jasmine. This adds a spicy, flowery touch that feels elegant and kind of addictive at the same time. The base smells are white amber, praline, moss, and white cedar. This gives Pure Addiction its rich depth. The creamy sweet of praline mixes perfectly with the wood and musk. 

This makes the scent cozy, sexy, and great for both guys and girls. Pure Addiction has that classy balance of sweet and warm that never smells too strong. Pure Addiction is a smell that slowly gets better on you. It's fresh first, then deep and smooth later. Franck Olivier Pure Addiction is perfect for people who like a sweet perfume but want a bit of edge and warmth too.

products.title: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Legere Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Légère Eau de Parfum is a modern, bold perfume for women. Launched in 2018, it is a lighter and fresher version of the original Good Girl, balancing sweet, floral, and warm notes perfectly. The fragrance opens with bright and fresh top notes of ylang-ylang, mandarin orange, bergamot, and lemon; the heart is full of floral beauty with tuberose, jasmine, orange blossom, and Bulgarian rose. The base adds depth with dulche de leche, praline, tonka bean, cinnamon, cashmerwood, sandalwood, musk, amber, patchouli, and cedar, leaving a warm, long-lasting trail.

products.title: Estee Lauder Pleasure For Men Eau De Cologne
products.body_html: Estee Lauder Pleasures For Men is a fresh, bright, and simple smell that has been a long-time favorite since the late 90s. The scent of this Eau De Parfum starts with grapefruit and watery notes, mixed with a smooth, soft sweetness from nectarine. The middle tone is warmer and spicy with ginger, peppery pimento, and clean lavender, which gives the cologne its manly feel. All of this settles onto a nice, solid base of deep sandalwood, warm ebony wood, and oakmoss. This whole scent feels like a relaxed, sunny afternoon.

products.title: Floraiku Between Two Trees Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Floraiku Between Two Trees Eau de Parfum feels like a quiet walk in nature on a fresh morning. It opens with the lively brightness of Grapefruit, giving a burst of energy that feels crisp and light. The scent slowly moves into the green heart of Mate, which adds a calm, earthy tone that feels warm and slightly smoky. The final note is woody and grounded, leaving behind a nice and clean trail of timeless fragrance. It is a perfect fit for someone looking for a gentle yet expressive fragrance. It gives off a fresh and outdoor-like feel, and is apt to wear at any occasion at any time of the day.

products.title: Women Daytime Discovery Set - Giorgio Armani Si Fiori, Ysl Libre, Giorgio Armani In Love With You
products.body_html:
Brighten your day with elegance and charm with our Women Daytime Discovery Set, featuring three delightful fragrances:

  • Giorgio Armani Si Fiori EDP: Embrace the delicate blend of floral and citrus notes, creating a fresh and radiant scent that’s perfect for daytime wear.
  • YSL Libre EDP: Experience the bold fusion of lavender essence and orange blossom, offering a powerful and sophisticated fragrance for the confident woman.
  • Giorgio Armani In Love With You EDP: Enjoy the modern and captivating scent of fruity and floral notes, embodying youthful energy and passion.

Curated for the modern woman, these fragrances are perfect for enhancing your daytime presence.

products.title: Franck Boclet Erotic Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Franck Boclet Erotic Eau De Parfum for Men & Women is a strong perfume. It is an incredible blend of warm spice and smooth wood notes. The scent kicks off with a fresh burst of rosemary, lemon, bergamot, and basil. This gives it a clean, slightly spicy opening. The middle layer has a lot going on: benzoin, heliotrope, cardamom, patchouli, tuberose, lavender, and oakmoss. This adds a lot of depth, plus creamy sweetness and rich herbs. The bottom notes are heavy. You get vanilla, amber, incense, sandalwood, and leather. Musk and cedar soften the whole thing up. This makes the entire scent finish deep and totally luxurious.

products.title: Chopard Jasmin Moghol Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Chopard Jasmin Moghol EDP is a luxurious fragrance for men and women. It opens with the soft, fresh scent of Chinese Jasmine that feels pure and uplifting. The middle notes combine Bulgarian Rose and Turkish Rose to give a romantic, flowery touch. Sandalwood in the base adds warmth and depth, making it perfect for evening wear. 

This perfume was created by Alberto Morillas in 2018, it is loved by fragrance lovers for its smooth floral aroma and balanced, long-lasting scent.

products.title: Carolina Herrera Very Good Girl Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Carolina Herrera Very Good Girl Eau de Parfum is a lively and charming fragrance for women. Launched in 2021, it has a playful and bold scent profile made from fresh, fruity, and floral notes. The top notes of litchi and red currant give it a sweet and juicy start, the heart of rose adds a delicate floral touch, and the base of vanilla and vetiver gives a warm and elegant finish. Very Good Girl is perfect for confident women who want a mix of fun and sophistication in one fragrance.

products.title: Franck Boclet Cocaine Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Franck Boclet Cocaine Eau De Parfum is an enticingly intense, blistering scent. It has that rich, sweet, luxurious feeling. It opens up with caramel, red berries, bitter orange, and tobacco; and feels creamy, smokey, and somehow fruity. The heart has tuberose, orchid, and lily, which creates a soft, weighty floral accord. In the base, monoi oil, vanilla, and patchouli develop warm, deep qualities. It has a definite presence, is fun yet very classy. There is sweet quality here, but also an earthy balance. It is a great fragrance for anyone into heavier, richer fragrances that last.

products.title: Elie Saab Girl Of Now Forever Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Elie Saab Girl Of Now Forever Eau De Parfum is described as joy in a bottle. It’s bright, juicy, and full of life fragrance makes it stand out. The fragrance has a cheerful splash of raspberry and zesty lemon peel, launching right into a sweet, vibrant start - that is sure to lift your spirits immediately. As the scent dried down, the heart tones present a blend of sweet almond, black currant, rose, and orange blossom. This feminine fragrance is perfect for any elegant, playful, pleasant look. The base notes are rooted in warm and cozy vibes with the scent of vanilla, patchouli, and musk. This fragrance feels like a warm hug. If you are a woman looking forward to a fresh and sweet scent, then this is for you.

products.title: Cartier Baiser Vole Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Cartier Baiser Vole Eau De Parfum is a delicate floral perfume made for women. It opens with fresh and sparkling notes of lily and citrus, which gives a soft and elegant feel. The heart is pure lily, keeping the floral theme alive, while the base is green lily and fresh green notes that make the perfume natural, light, and refreshing. It is perfect for women who like soft, floral, and graceful scents that feel fresh all day.

products.title: Carolina Herrera Vetiver Paradise Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Carolina Herrera Vetiver Paradise Eau de Parfum is a unisex perfume with a fresh, woody, and spicy character. Launched in 2017, it combines bright citrus, warm spices, and earthy woody notes into a smooth and elegant composition. The perfume opens with fresh top notes of bergamot, grapefruit, and pink pepper, moves into a spicy and floral heart of neroli, nutmeg, and cardamom, and finally settles into a grounding base of vetiver and woody notes. It is a versatile scent perfect for daily wear or special occasions.

products.title: Tom Ford Grey Vetiver Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Grey Vetiver Parfum is a new fragrance by the designer Tom Ford, which contains a clean, elegant and modern aura for men. It was released in 2023 with a new version that was deeper, richer and smoother than previous ones. The composition starts with a fresh, slightly floral note, followed by a spicy one and then the vetiver base with its strong earthy quality takes over.

products.title: Ex Nihilo Viper Green Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ex Nihilo Viper Green Eau de Parfum is a truly confident and lively fragrance – it’s a natural scent. Viper Green is elegant and fully audacious at the same time and is a great fit for a person who likes the cool contrast of feeling fresh but warm at the same time. The scent has that luxury clean aspect, but that unique green bite, distinguishes it from the other standard citrus or floral fragrances out there. That specific citrus in woods helps Viper Green enact a niche in greater appeal with people who desire sophistication, but also differentiate it from traditional fragrance to one that exhibits an edge.

products.title: Diptyque  Creme Rich Butter
products.body_html:
Driven by the Byzantine rose, this smooth cream, as luscious and addictive as Turkish delight, quenches dry skin.
As luxurious as fresh butter, this care product envelops the body in a delicate perfume. In its sillage, Damask rose mingles with myrrh and the power of Peru balsam.

products.title: Riiffs Stella & Luna Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Stella & Luna Extrait de Parfum is a rich and sweet fragrance made for women who love warm and creamy scents. The opening feels nutty and smooth with black currant, hazelnut, milk and praline, giving a soft gourmand touch. In the heart, rose, jasmine, and iris add a floral beauty, while cacao brings a slight chocolate feel. The base is deep and warm with vanilla, honey, musk and sandalwood that stays on skin for long hours. It feels elegant, cozy and a little addictive.

products.title: Abdul Samad Al Qurashi Safari Blue Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Abdul Samad Al Qurashi Safari Blue Eau de Parfum is a fresh and modern unisex fragrance from Abdul Samad Al Qurashi. Launched in 2024, this scent feels clean, airy and refreshing from the first spray. Abdul Samad Al Qurashi Safari Blue Eau de Parfum opens with bright citrus and spice, then moves into a calm lavender heart and finally settles into a soft, earthy base.

products.title: Riiffs Surge & Spectra Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs R Spectra Eau dePerfum is an assertive and hot fragrance that is both hot and somewhat sweet to the touch of the man. It has a combination of orange blossom and white pepper as the beginning, which makes it fresh and sharp. As it subsides, you have warm violet, nutmeg and sweetness. Amber, vanilla bean and patchouli provide a rich, smooth and extended low in the dry down. It is contemporary, masculine, and suitable for those men who use oriental spicy perfumes that are very rich.

products.title: Riiffs Samah Ruby Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Samah Ruby Extrait de Parfum is a women's perfume that is warm and elegant, and it is sweet, flowery, and slightly spicy. It opens bright with bergamot, orange and blackcurrant combined with sweet notes and saffron to give it a good first impression. It is smooth and feminine, and as if out of nothing, slow and soft jasmine and violet emerge. The foundation of musk, amber, cashmeran, and moss remains long-lasting on the skin and is comfortable, deep, and luxurious for hours.
